data.jd_text:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in technical program management, with a focus on infrastructure projects.
* 5 years of experience in a leadership role with direct reports.
* Experience in both fiber optic network design/deployment (OSP) and data center infrastructure (ISP).


**Preferred qualifications:**
* 10 years of multi\-disciplinary experience in network, fiber, electrical, and mechanical (cooling) systems.
* Experience working with global carriers and stakeholders in the EMEA and APAC telecommunications and data center markets.
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to navigate through ambiguity and build consensus among high\-level executive stakeholders.
* Proven track record in New Product Initiatives (NPI), specifically in defining standards for deployable infrastructure solutions.


**About The Job**
 Google's projects, like our users, span the globe and require managers to keep the big picture in focus while being able to dive into the unique engineering challenges we face daily. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you lead complex, multi\-disciplinary engineering projects using your engineering expertise. You plan requirements with internal customers and usher projects through the entire project lifecycle. This includes managing project schedules, identifying risks and clearly communicating them to project stakeholders. You're equally at home explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical trade\-offs in product development with engineers.
   

  

 Using your extensive technical and leadership expertise, you manage various Engineering\-specific programs and teams.
   

  

 The Fiber Infrastructure Engineering and Delivery team is a unified organization within Google Global Infrastructure, integrating the expertise of capacity infrastructure engineering, network infrastructure engineering, and fiber and capacity delivery. Our mission is to deliver the resilient long\-haul and metro fiber assets and data center network space that power Google's global growth and AI leadership. We operate at the intersection of cutting\-edge technology and global scale, ensuring Google’s network infrastructure is the most reliable and efficient on the planet.
   

  

 This role requires approximately 25% travel, mostly to Google’s data centers around the globe.
   

  

 Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Orchestrate program strategy across East EU and MENA to drive consistency and economies of scale. Be able to strengthen alignment between technical requirements and business objectives by providing advanced insights facilitating executive decision\-making.
* Define requirements for the Google Global Network, designing data center infrastructure (space, power, cooling) and define new product deployment globally.
* Manage complex relationships globally. Influence and collaborate with design engineering firms, carriers, internal engineering teams, and senior executives to solve large\-scale network growth challenges.
* Establish systems to identify and implement innovative solutions that optimize project delivery. Manage risks and drive improvements in lead\-time, predictability, and cost\-effectiveness.
* Lead a global team of technical program managers. Foster growth mindset and culture of learning, ensuring the team's skills are transferable across technical domains.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

data.jd_text:
A high\-growth, multi\-asset trading group is hiring a Head of Product \& PMO to lead the performance of its trading ecosystem and the execution of strategic initiatives across global operations. The business runs two regulated trading platforms covering FX, CFDs and equities on one side, and crypto spot, perpetual futures, margin and copy trading on the other, serving retail, high\-net\-worth and institutional clients across multiple jurisdictions.
 



  





 This is a dual mandate sitting at the intersection of commercial product leadership and disciplined programme delivery. You will own the product P\&L across crypto and traditional asset classes, shape monetisation strategy, and stand up the PMO function that governs how initiatives are planned, prioritised and delivered across the group.
 



  





**What you will lead** 



* Product strategy and monetisation across all trading products, with continuous refinement based on performance data, competitor moves and market dynamics.
* Full product P\&L ownership across crypto and traditional offerings, driving revenue growth, profitability and unit economics across every product line.
* Establishment and leadership of the PMO function, including governance frameworks, standardised processes, reporting and delivery tracking across all strategic initiatives.
* User acquisition, activation, retention and lifetime value strategy, with constant optimisation of user journeys, trading activity and product stickiness.
* Pricing architecture across trading fees, spreads and liquidity incentive structures, balancing competitiveness with revenue optimisation.
* Data\-driven experimentation and delivery measurement, with structured frameworks for both product and programme outcomes.
* Cross\-functional alignment across Trading, Technology, Marketing, Sales and Operations, ensuring the PMO drives genuine coordination rather than reporting overhead.
* Global expansion and regional product adaptation, maintaining global consistency while tuning for local market fit.
* Leadership and scaling of both the Product and PMO teams, with clear KPIs, accountability and a high\-performance culture.



  





**What we are looking for** 



* 8 to 12\+ years in product management and/or programme management, ideally within crypto, trading, FinTech or financial services. Proven track record of owning product P\&L and delivering complex cross\-functional initiatives. Strong understanding of trading platforms, market structures and monetisation. Experience establishing or running PMO functions and delivery frameworks. Data\-driven analytical mindset. Track record of leading high\-performing product and project teams in fast\-paced, high\-growth environments.
* Preferred: exposure across both crypto and traditional financial products, deep understanding of trading behaviour, liquidity and execution dynamics, multi\-market product and delivery experience, and fluency with Agile, Scrum or hybrid delivery methodologies.



  





**Location** 




 Dubai, onsite. Relocation supported
 








**PACKAGE** 




**Base salary in the region of USD 120,000 to 130,000 per annum, paid in AED. Performance\-related annual bonus. ESOP participation. Standard UAE benefits**

 Parsons is seeking an exceptional

 to lead the delivery of a landmark multi\-stage, multi\-discipline rail consultancy programme in the UAE. data.jd_text:
**About Moove**
 Moove is building the world’s largest fleet and best\-in\-class technologies that power mobility platforms. Its flagship Drive\-to\-Own (DTO) product democratises access to vehicle ownership with a revolutionary revenue based financing model, enabling underserved mobility entrepreneurs to thrive.
   

  

 Moove’s growth has been fuelled by its global Uber partnership and support of leading investors and lenders, including Uber, Mubadala, BlackRock, MUFG, and many others. With operations now spanning 19 cities across 6 continents \- Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, South America, and the Middle East \- Moove continues to expand its offerings through strategic acquisitions and partnerships with industry leaders, including Waymo and Uber. Moove is transforming mobility to make it safer, more efficient and accessible to all, while providing economic opportunities and supporting skills development in the mobility sector.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Director of Performance \& Strategy at Moove is responsible for driving business performance, planning discipline, and execution across markets. This role owns the end\-to\-end performance management cycle, including running business reviews, leading planning processes, and identifying and driving resolution of key performance issues in partnership with market and functional leaders. In parallel, you will act as a strategic partner to local teams, supporting critical decisions on growth, profitability, pricing, and expansion, while aligning cross\-functional stakeholders. The role also leads key strategic initiatives, including new market launches, new business lines (e.g. AV), and other growth opportunities, ensuring disciplined execution from planning through implementation.
   

  

**This role is a "temp role" of 6 months.**
**What You’ll Be Doing**
 As Moove scales across markets, this role ensures consistent delivery across four core areas: business performance, project management across centrally driven initiatives, expansion, and cross\-functional execution.
   

  

 Critical outcomes (6–12 months)
   

  

* Establish a consistent performance management cadence across markets (SteerCos, dashboards, planning cycles)
* Identify and address key drivers of underperformance, improving profitability and operational efficiency
* Deliver high\-impact strategic initiatives (e.g., market launches, pricing improvements, new revenue streams)


 Scope of responsibilities \& impact areas
   

  

* Performance Management: Own weekly and monthly business reviews, track key metrics, and lead deep dives to understand performance drivers and gaps
* Strategic Planning: Lead annual budgeting, OKRs, and quarterly planning processes, ensuring alignment between company goals and market execution
* Market Support: Provide hands\-on support to local teams on growth, profitability, pricing, and expansion decisions through structured analysis
* Cross\-Functional Alignment: Work closely with Finance, Legal, Tech, and Operations to resolve issues and ensure delivery of key priorities
* Data \& Reporting: Partner with Data/BI teams to build and maintain accurate, automated dashboards, ensuring a single source of truth and reducing manual reporting
* Central Program Management: Track and manage key strategic commitments, ensuring accountability and timely execution across teams
* Expansion \& Growth: Support and lead new market launches, new categories, and other strategic initiatives from evaluation through implementation


**What You Will Need For This Position**
 Experience:
   

  

* 10\-12\+ years of experience in strategy, operations, consulting, or similar roles in high\-growth environments
* Strong track record of driving business performance and solving complex operational problems
* Experience working across multiple markets or regions is preferred


 Education \& Skills:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related field Strong analytical skills with experience in data analysis and financial modeling
* Familiarity with BI tools
* Solid understanding of unit economics, cost structures, and performance drivers


 Behavioural \& Leadership Traits:
   

  

* Structured problem\-solver with strong attention to detail
* Ability to manage stakeholders and influence decisions across teams
* Clear and effective communicator, including with senior leadership
* High ownership and ability to operate in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments
* Focus on execution and delivering measurable outcomes


**Key Metrics**
**I** 
 mprovement in core business metrics such as revenue growth, utilization, contribution margin, and cashflow
   

  

* Effectiveness of performance management processes (e.g., quality and consistency of reviews, dashboard adoption)
* Successful delivery of strategic initiatives, including market launches and new revenue streams


**Who You'll Be Working with:**
 Directly reporting to our CEO Moove, and closely working with our Central OperationsTeam.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our team is collaborative, positive, curious, and engaged. We think fast, work smart, laugh often, and are looking for like\-minded people to join us in our mission to disrupt vehicle ownership and make financial freedom within reach.
   

  

 Moove is strongly committed to diversity within its community. The Company’s approved Employment Equity Plan and Targets will be considered as part of the recruitment process. As an Equal Opportunities employer, we welcome people from all backgrounds who seek the opportunity to help build a future where everyone and everything can move independently.
   

  

**Pre\-hiring Notice:** 
 Moove relies on the accuracy of information contained in employment applications, as well as the accuracy of other data presented throughout the hiring process and during employment. Any misrepresentations, falsifications, or material omissions in any information or data provided by an applicant may result in the applicant being excluded from further consideration for employment or if an individual has already been hired, termination of employment.
   

  

**EEO Statement:** 
 Moove is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, race, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, political affiliation or any other protected characteristic.

**Job Overview
 
 :** 




 The Projects Director is responsible for the strategic leadership, governance, and successful delivery of all projects within the organization. The role oversees the full project lifecycle from pre\-construction through execution and handover, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. The Projects Director operates as the senior authority across all project teams, aligning engineering, procurement, commercial, and site operations with the company’s business objectives and premium construction standards.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities
 
 :** 




 Strategic Leadership \& Portfolio Management
 


* Lead and oversee the entire project portfolio from inception to final handover.
* Define project governance structures, reporting frameworks, and performance benchmarks.
* Align project execution strategy with corporate financial and operational objectives.
* Review and approve master schedules, budgets, and procurement strategies.
* Establish project performance KPIs, including cost variance, schedule variance, productivity, and margin.



 Project Execution \& Operational Excellence
 


* Ensure projects are delivered in accordance with contractual obligations and company standards.
* Monitor progress across multiple projects and intervene proactively to resolve bottlenecks.
* Ensure effective coordination between engineering, procurement, commercial, and site teams.
* Drive continuous improvement in construction methodologies and resource utilization.
* Ensure strict adherence to approved drawings, specifications, and quality benchmarks.



 Financial \& Commercial Management
 


* Oversee project budgeting, forecasting, and cost control mechanisms.
* Review and approve major variations, subcontractor agreements, and commercial negotiations.
* Safeguard project profitability, cash flow, and margin performance.
* Monitor procurement efficiency and material cost optimization.
* Ensure proper contract administration and claims management practices.



 Risk, Compliance \& Governance
 


* Ensure compliance with UAE construction regulations, safety standards, and contractual requirements.
* Implement enterprise\-level risk mitigation strategies across all active projects.
* Promote and enforce a strong HSE culture with zero\-incident objectives.
* Ensure implementation of quality assurance and quality control systems across sites.



 Leadership \& Stakeholder Management
 


* Lead, mentor, and evaluate Project Managers, Construction Managers, and Engineering teams.
* Act as the executive representative for clients, consultants, and regulatory authorities.
* Ensure high levels of client satisfaction through proactive communication and resolution of concerns.
* Strengthen cross\-functional collaboration to ensure seamless project execution.
* Support succession planning and capability development within the project's function.



 Personal Attributes:
 


* Strong leadership qualities with the ability to manage a diverse team and maintain project momentum.
* Strategic thinker with strong commercial acumen.
* Results\-driven with a high accountability and ownership mindset.
* Highly organized and detail\-oriented with a problem\-solving mindset.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines while maintaining quality standards.
* High level of professionalism and discretion when handling sensitive information.
* Strong commitment to safety and quality on\-site.



  





**Requirements
 
 :** 



* A minimum of 15 to 20 years of progressive experience in construction project management, with a proven track record working with reputable contracting companies in the UAE.
* Proven experience in managing luxury projects,
 **including high\-end villas** 
 , with a strong understanding of premium construction standards and finishes.
* Demonstrated success in leading multi\-project portfolios within the UAE or GCC region.



  





**Qualification
 
 :** 



* Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, or a related field from a recognized university.
* Master’s Degree or professional certifications (PMP, RICS, etc.) preferred.

**INSPIRE \| EXHILARATE \| DELIGHT**
 For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.
   

  

 Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.
   

  

 Chalhoub Group fosters a people\-at\-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future\-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM. Their collective efforts have earned the Group the Great Place to Work® certification in several markets.
   

  

 Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040\.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 The Transformation Program Governance Director provides strategic oversight and leadership across the Group’s multi\-year digital transformation program. This role ensures disciplined execution, strategic alignment, and value realization across all streams, while acting as the guardian of program governance, standards, and vendor accountability. Operating at Group level, this leader drives cross\-entity alignment, embeds best\-in\-class governance frameworks, and establishes the program as a benchmark for disciplined transformation delivery.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Lead executive governance for the entire digital transformation program, strategically allocating resources, budgets, and priorities to maximize business impact.
* Safeguard program outcomes by overseeing benefit realization and hold workstreams accountable for delivering measurable value and results.
* Support and challenge program leaders to ensure delivery excellence, proactively managing risks, dependencies, and barriers.
* Provide senior leadership with data\-driven insights, independent assurance, and strategic recommendations to guide decision\-making.
* Define, document and continuously evolve Group\-wide governance frameworks, standards, and policies to ensure consistent and mature program delivery.
* Establish and maintain a Transformation Governance Center of Excellence (CoE) offering tools, methodologies, and training for standardized delivery.
* Uphold governance rigor by designing and maintaining clear decision\-making structures, reporting mechanisms, and escalation protocols that ensure transparency and accountability at all levels.
* Act as a senior escalation point and manage strategic vendor relationships, ensuring partners meet contractual commitments, quality standards, and timely delivery.
* Shape vendor engagement models and collaborate with Procurement, Legal, and Finance to optimize commercial terms, risk management and cost control across all vendor engagements.
* Ensure alignment across Group entities and business units, so that transformation initiatives are integrated seamlessly into the operating model and enable scalable adoption.
* Drive transparent, timely reporting and foster collaboration across geographies and functions to maintain senior stakeholder engagement and informed executive committees and SteerCos, enabling informed decision\-making and program steering.


**What You’ll Need To Succeed**
* Proven experience in leading governance and execution for large\-scale, multi\-year digital transformation programs, ideally in a multi\-entity or international group context.
* Deep expertise in governance design, operating models, and transformation frameworks, with a track record of institutionalizing standards at Group level.
* Strong leadership and influencing skills, with the ability to engage at C\-suite and Board level.
* Demonstrated success in vendor and partner governance, including complex system integrator or technology engagements.
* Strategic thinker with operational discipline, able to balance control, flexibility, and delivery speed.
* Excellent communication, diplomacy, and stakeholder management skills across diverse cultures and functions.


**What We Can Offer You**
 With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.
   

  

 We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts.
   

  

**Using GenAI in Your Application Process**
 To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations.
   

  

**We Invite All Applicants to Apply**
 It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity.
   

  

 We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

**Leadership \& Strategy**
* Provide strategic leadership for a portfolio of major transport and infrastructure programmes, aligning delivery priorities with business objectives, client needs, and regional market opportunities.
* Shape market positioning and support business growth through key account development, pursuit strategy, proposal leadership, and executive\-level client engagement.
* Establish clear governance, decision\-making frameworks, and performance expectations across programmes to support consistent, high\-quality delivery.
* Represent the business externally with clients, partners, and industry stakeholders, strengthening market profile and helping secure future opportunities.

* Lead the delivery of major transport and infrastructure projects from concept through detailed design and construction support, ensuring programmes are structured, resourced, and governed effectively.

* Oversee resource planning and coordination across multi\-disciplinary teams to maintain delivery efficiency and effective interface management.


**Client \& Stakeholder Engagement**
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with key clients, government authorities, and strategic partners across the region, including ministries, commissions, municipalities, and major development entities.
* Act as the senior client interface for major programmes, leading executive discussions, resolving complex issues, and maintaining confidence in delivery performance and commercial outcomes.
* Oversee stakeholder coordination and authority engagement, including support for approvals, permitting, and resolution of issues affecting programme progress.

* Provide technical leadership across engineering solutions, mobility strategies, and design methodologies, ensuring that projects are innovative, practical, and aligned with client objectives.
* Ensure robust technical assurance and compliance with international standards, local authority requirements, design safety obligations, and organisational quality systems.
* Champion digital engineering, BIM, model\-based delivery, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance quality, efficiency, and consistency across programmes.


**Team Leadership \& Development**
* Lead, mentor, and inspire high\-performing multi\-disciplinary teams, setting clear expectations for delivery, collaboration, and professional standards.

* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and client‑facing skills with experience engaging with ministries and major authorities.
* Strong commercial and contractual acumen, including experience with bid leadership, consultancy frameworks, contract strategy, procurement interfaces, change management, and programme financial performance.
* Experience managing programme performance through governance, reporting, KPIs, and executive\-level decision\-making in high\-profile delivery environments.
* Experience working with large engineering consultancies on high\-profile regional projects.
* Chartered/Professional Engineer status (CEng, PE, PEng, etc.) is highly desirable.

**Job Description**
**About Us**
 Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
   

  

 At Visa, youll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
   

  

 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
   

  

****Job Description****
 Team Summary:
   

  

 The Executive Talent Acquisition team at Visa plays a strategic role in shaping the company’s leadership pipeline and driving its long\-term vision. This team manages full\-cycle executive recruitment globally, from sourcing and market mapping to candidate assessment and onboarding, ensuring Visa hires the right leaders to support Visa’s growth.
   

  

 What a Director, Executive Talent Acquisition, CEMEA does at Visa:
   

  

* Owns and leads Executive Talent Acquisition strategy and delivery for CEMEA, ensuring alignment with Visa’s global Executive TA framework while adapting approaches to local and regional market needs.
* Acts as a trusted strategic adviser to senior executives in CEMEA, providing market intelligence, talent insights and guidance on executive hiring decisions.
* Builds strong partnerships with People Team partners and leadership teams to anticipate future leadership capability needs.
* Partners with Global TA Leadership to evaluate and adopt emerging AI capabilities that improve executive hiring efficiency, decision making and candidate experience across the region.
* Contributes to the Global Executive Talent Acquisition strategy, collaborating with Executive TA leaders across Research, Coordination, AP, CEMEA, LAC and North America to drive consistency, innovation and best\-practice sharing.
* Partners with Global Exec TA leaders to design and execute global TA initiatives and operational enhancements that improve scalability, governance and executive hiring outcomes across regions.
* Ensures regional compliance with global processes and executive hiring standards.
* Sets clear performance expectations, coaches on executive search excellence, drives accountability and supports career development across the team.
* Oversees workload prioritisation and resource planning to ensure seamless execution of multiple, high\-impact executive searches.
* Coaches and upskills the Executive TA team on the effective and responsible use of AI and automation, embedding data\-driven decision making into executive search delivery.
* Manages a complex portfolio of senior\-level executive searches across CEMEA, balancing competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Develops and deploys client\-specific executive recruiting strategies, including proactive market mapping and talent pipelining.
* Partners with internal teams including Workforce Planning, ETA Research, Coordination, Preboarding, Total Rewards and Talent Management to deliver a seamless end\-to\-end hiring experience.
* Leverages advanced data analytics and reporting (ATS, Excel, Talent Insights tools) to assess performance, identify trends and inform decision\-making.
* Provides regular insights to Global TA Leadership and business leaders on talent availability, competitor activity and hiring risks.
* Stays current on CEMEA labour markets, regulatory considerations, industry news and executive compensation trends.
* Champions Visa’s employer brand in the CEMEA executive talent market, ensuring an exceptional, high\-touch candidate experience.
* Represents Visa with professionalism, discretion and credibility when engaging senior external talent.
* Supports branding, process improvement and candidate engagement initiatives as part of broader TA projects.


**Why This Is Important To Visa**
 The CEMEA region spans highly diverse, fast‑growing, and complex markets where leadership capability directly determines business performance and risk management. This role owns and leads executive TA strategy and delivery across CEMEA, ensuring Visa attracts and appoints senior leaders who can navigate regulatory complexity, geopolitical variation and differing market maturity while remaining aligned to Visa’s global strategy and standards. Acting as a trusted adviser to CEMEA executives, this role brings forward market intelligence, succession insights and transparent decision‑making to support critical VP and SVP appointments, while also strengthening internal mobility and long‑term leadership pipelines. By connecting regional needs to the global Executive TA framework, the role ensures consistency, governance and innovation in how Visa builds leadership capability across one of its most strategically important growth regions.
   

  

 This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.
   

  

****Qualifications****
* 12\+ years of experience in Executive Talent Acquisition or executive search in complex, multinational environments.
* Proven track record delivering senior executive hires across any markets in the CEMEA region, ideally within financial services, payments, technology or global matrixed organisations.
* Deep understanding of CEMEA talent markets, cultural nuances and cross\-border hiring considerations.
* Passion for inclusive hiring, data\-driven decision\-making and continuous improvement.
* Experience with Applicant Tracking Systems.
* Highly advanced reporting and data analytics experience to identify hiring challenges and gaps.
* Ability to operate at both strategic and operational levels, influencing senior stakeholders while driving execution excellence.
* Results\-oriented, self\-motivated, organised and resourceful.
* Detail\-oriented with a proven track record of juggling multiple tasks and meeting various deadlines.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

data.jd_text:
**About Moove** 




 Moove is a global mobility fintech and operations company focused on transforming mobility through innovative fleet solutions, mobility, and next\-generation transportation technologies. As we expand our operations across the UAE and GCC region, we are looking for an experienced and highly driven Project Manager to support the launch and scaling of new mobility and automotive projects.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 This role leads the planning, coordination, and execution of new mobility and automotive projects across the UAE. Working closely with internal teams, OEM partners, technology providers, and strategic stakeholders, the Program Manager drives initiatives from concept through commercial launch ensuring Moove’s expansion is delivered on time, at scale, and to the highest operational standard.
 



 The role requires strong project management expertise, stakeholder coordination, and a working understanding of the mobility ecosystem. The ideal candidate has 5–7 years of experience in project or program management, with a track record of delivering complex, cross\-functional initiatives in mobility, fleet, logistics, or adjacent sectors.
 



  





**What You’ll be Doing** 




 The role exists to own end\-to\-end delivery of mobility projects across the UAE from initial scoping through pilot and into commercial launch. Success is measured by projects delivered on time, within budget, and at the quality standard required for Moove to scale its regional operations.
 



 Within the first 6 months, the role is expected to own at least one active project end\-to\-end, establish clear project governance and reporting cadence for the leadership team, and build the operational frameworks that enable future market launches to be faster and more repeatable.
 



  





 Core Responsibilities
 


* Lead end\-to\-end project management for mobility and automotive projects across the UAE.
* Develop detailed project plans, timelines, budgets, and execution frameworks for new market launches.
* Manage cross\-functional teams across Operations, Engineering, Compliance, Fleet, Safety, and Technology.
* Drive project execution from pilot phase through commercial launch, owning delivery outcomes end\-to\-end.
* Monitor project risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans; escalate issues proactively to senior leadership.
* Lead vendor management, OEM partner onboarding, and operational integration activities across GCC markets.
* Ensure compliance with transportation, safety, and operational standards.
* Prepare executive dashboards, management reports, operational updates, and board presentations.
* Build scalable operational processes and frameworks to enable faster and more repeatable expansion.
* Perform operational analysis, reporting, forecasting, and data tracking using advanced Excel and BI tools.



  





**What You will need for this position** 



* Experience: 5–7 years in project or program management within mobility, transportation, fleet operations, logistics, or technology; proven track record of delivering cross\-functional projects end\-to\-end in a fast\-paced environment.
* Education / Skills: Bachelor’s in Engineering, Business, Transportation, or Technology; PMP or equivalent preferred; advanced Excel and BI tools proficiency required.
* Traits: Exceptional stakeholder management, highly analytical, comfortable with ambiguity, GCC market\-savvy, strong communicator, and able to lead without authority across complex cross\-functional teams.



  





**Key Metrics** 



* On\-time, on\-budget delivery of mobility projects across UAE.
* Quality and accuracy of executive dashboards, project reporting, and operational updates.
* Stakeholder satisfaction across internal functions and external OEM and technology partners.
* Speed and repeatability of new market launches enabled by scalable operational frameworks.
* Compliance and risk management across all active projects and UAE market operations.



  





**Who You'll Be Working with:** 




 Directly reporting to our Managing Director, and closely working with our UAE Operations Team.
 



  





**About the team** 




 Our team is collaborative, positive, curious, and engaged. We think fast, work smart, laugh often, and are looking for like\-minded people to join us in our mission to disrupt vehicle ownership and make financial freedom within reach.
 



 Moove is strongly committed to diversity within its community. The Company’s approved Employment Equity Plan and Targets will be considered as part of the recruitment process. As an Equal Opportunities employer, we welcome people from all backgrounds who seek the opportunity to help build a future where everyone and everything can move independently.

Any misrepresentations, falsifications, or material omissions in any information or data provided by an applicant may result in the applicant being excluded from further consideration for employment or if an individual has already been hired, termination of employment.

The person will be responsible for ensuring the best customer experience in Amazon Now. They will be responsible to improve the customer shopping experience through driving projects on catalog enhancement, ensuring we display meaningful and correct information to customers, improving search performance. The tasks handled by this person will have a direct impact on customer buying decisions and online user experience.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Ensure product listing is accurate for new and existing products
* Troubleshoot and drive resolutions to ensure reliable and operationally effective flow of products; improve processes and reduce discrepancies

* Drive appropriate data oriented analysis, adoption of solutions and process improvement projects to achieve operational and business goals
* Manage stakeholder communication across multiple lines of business on operational milestones, process changes and escalations
* Proactively identify issues and opportunities in catalog/CX of listed products and respond accordingly ( and engaging cross functional teams where necessary)
* Analyzing and sharing relevant metrics and best practices from the executed initiatives across the organization. Build relevant dashboard and publish reports to ensure business is moving in right direction.
* Contribute in Business Review with customer experience and data backed decisions.


 A day in the life
   

  

 Understand the guidelines and guardrails for listing a products in Amazon Now and ensure they are met at all time. Dive deep and understand different systems and processes that impact customer buying decision. Identify root causes for product details defects, work with category SMEs WW and Tech teams to work on implementing Corrective\-Preventive Action and and identify opportunities for Automation. Analyze data and highlights gaps, recommending solutions, driving/influencing inter\-function decisions.

* 2\+ years of program or project management experience
* Knowledge of SQL and Advanced Excel (Array and Statistical formulas)
* Experience using data to influence business decisions
* Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of analytics \& statistical tools such as SAS, PowerBI, SQL \& ETL DW concepts

data.jd_text:
📍 Dubai, United Arab Emirates
   

  

 🌍 International Business \| Shipping \| Commodity Trading \| Strategic Ventures
   

  

**An Exceptional Career Opportunity for an Ambitious and Dynamic Professional**
 Aegis Group is a Dubai\-based international business group active in global commodity trading, dry bulk shipping, logistics, and strategic investments across international markets.
   

  

 We are seeking a highly capable, polished, intelligent, and energetic Executive Assistant to work directly alongside the Founder \& Managing Director in a fast\-moving, entrepreneurial, and globally connected business environment.
   

  

 This is far more than a conventional Executive Assistant role.
   

  

 It is an opportunity to become closely involved in the daily workings of an entrepreneurial business leader operating across international trade, shipping, investments, strategic projects, hospitality, corporate relationships, and high\-level business coordination.
   

  

 The role offers rare exposure, accelerated personal growth, and the opportunity to develop into a highly sophisticated business professional operating at the center of decision\-making and execution.
   

  

**Why This Role Is Unique**
 The selected candidate will work closely with the Founder and gain exposure to:
   

  

* International business operations
* Strategic decision\-making
* Global commodity and shipping markets
* Executive communication and negotiations
* Business development and stakeholder management
* Corporate operations and coordination
* International travel and hospitality coordination
* High\-level meetings and business interactions
* Entrepreneurial thinking and problem solving
* Real\-world business execution across multiple industries


 No two days will be the same.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who enjoys variety, responsibility, fast learning, and working in a dynamic environment where initiative, intelligence, and adaptability are highly valued.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 You will become an integral part of the Office of the Managing Director, supporting both professional and executive activities with a high degree of trust, ownership, and confidentiality.
   

  

 Your responsibilities may include:
   

  

* Executive calendar and schedule management
* Coordinating meetings, travel, and appointments
* Business correspondence and communication
* Following up with clients, vendors, consultants, and stakeholders
* Assisting in project coordination and execution
* Preparing presentations, reports, and documentation
* Managing priorities and helping optimize executive workflow
* Supporting business events, hospitality, and guest coordination
* Conducting research and assisting with strategic initiatives
* Handling sensitive and confidential matters with professionalism and discretion


**Who We Are Looking For**
 We are looking for individuals with strong personality, maturity, emotional intelligence, and a genuine desire to grow professionally and personally.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is:
   

  

* Highly organized and detail\-oriented
* Intelligent and commercially aware
* Energetic, adaptable, and proactive
* Elegant and professional in communication and presentation
* Calm under pressure and solution\-oriented
* Able to multitask and prioritize effectively
* Comfortable working closely with leadership
* Curious, ambitious, and eager to learn


 This role is particularly suited for candidates seeking meaningful long\-term growth rather than a routine administrative job.
   

  

**Preferred Backgrounds**
 Candidates with experience in any of the following areas are encouraged to apply:
   

  

* Executive Assistant / Executive Office roles
* Founder's Office or Office Management
* Luxury hospitality or premium client servicing
* Airline or international hospitality industry
* Consulting or multinational environments
* Private office or family office support


 Business operations or coordination roles
   

  

**Requirements**
 Applicants should be comfortable using:
   

  

* Microsoft Office Suite
* Google Workspace
* Online meeting and collaboration tools
* Presentation and document preparation software
* Scheduling and coordination platforms
* Notion
* Slack


 Experience with AI productivity tools, CRM systems, project management tools, or HR systems will be considered advantageous.
   

  

 The candidate should have fluent in English and one other foreign language.
   

  

**Benefits**
**What We Offer**
* Attractive tax\-free salary package
* UAE employment visa and medical insurance
* Exposure to international business and leadership
* Direct mentorship and close interaction with the Founder
* Dynamic and multicultural working environment
* Significant learning and personality development opportunity
* Long\-term career growth within the organization

data.jd_text:
**Description**
**Zutari: Co\-creating an engineered impact.**
 Zutari is a well\-established, management\-owned engineering firm with almost 90 years' experience. As human\-centred engineering consultants and advisors, we are trusted by our clients, business partners, communities and other stakeholders across Africa.
   

  

 We co\-create engineering solutions that have a positive impact and improve people's lives. Zutari values inclusion and recognises the importance of a diverse, talented workforce, believing that people need other people to succeed.
   

  

**What kind of talent do we pursue?**
 We employ people with the right attitude and a positive mindset, who are motivated by doing the right thing, getting things done and share a sense of urgency. People who have an impact in our teams and broader community. People who think differently and connect with those around them to co\-create new opportunities and leave a meaningful legacy.
   

  

**About the role:**
 As
 **Operations Director: Built Environment** 
 for
 **Zutari MENA** 
 , based in
 **Dubai** 
 , you will play a critical role in driving the operational success, delivery excellence, and commercial performance of Zutari’s Build Environment portfolio across the Middle East and North Africa.
   

  

 This role is responsible for operationalising sector strategy, leading day\-to\-day business operations, enabling consistent high\-quality project delivery, and strengthening collaboration across technical, commercial, and support teams. The incumbent will ensure that Zutari’s Built Environment operations are positioned for sustainable growth, market relevance, and exceptional client outcomes across sectors such as commercial, mixed\-use, hospitality, healthcare, education, leisure and entertainment, aviation, and public infrastructure. The role entails strong Zutari inter\-departmental relationships and a We Are One mindset.
   

  

 This is a senior leadership role requiring strong operational discipline, strategic insight, sound commercial judgment, and the ability to build trusted relationships with clients, partners, and internal stakeholders. The role will also establish operational goals, performance metrics, and KPIs to monitor business unit health, project performance, and delivery effectiveness.
   

  

 The incumbent will be expected to travel across the
 **MENA region** 
 as required to support clients, projects, and partner engagement
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy formulation and operational implementation**
* Contribute to the development and refinement of the Built Environment strategy for Zutari MENA, aligned to the broader regional and group business objectives.
* Translate strategy into operational priorities, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes across the business unit.
* Monitor implementation of strategic initiatives and intervene where required to improve execution.
* Provide market and project delivery insights to identify growth opportunities, strengthen competitiveness, and respond to evolving client needs.
* Support market penetration in priority MENA geographies through operational readiness, delivery capability, and partner alignment.
* Grow Zutaris’ service offerings in the region to align with client and market expectations, as well as overall MENA and Group strategies.
* Drive digitally focused solutions through the team to ensure efficiency, market relevance and increased quality in delivery.


**Service delivery and risk mitigation**
* Support the development of strong client and stakeholder relationships to understand needs and deliver tailored Built Environment solutions.
* Review project technical and commercial delivery approaches, including risk elements, prior to contract award to minimise downstream delivery risk.
* Ensure projects are set up in line with Zutari’s delivery requirements, including digital delivery, knowledge management, resourcing, health and safety, quality, and environmental compliance.
* Appoint and support appropriate Project Executives, Design Leads, and Opportunity Managers to lead opportunities and projects from inception to close\-out.
* Ensure successful delivery of projects across the Built Environment portfolio in line with quality, programme, commercial, and client expectations.
* Monitor project performance proactively to identify delivery, commercial, contractual, technical, or reputational risks and ensure timely mitigation.
* Escalate material risks to the appropriate governance and leadership levels.
* Oversee delivery assurance across key disciplines such as mechanical, electrical, public health, fire engineering, specialist systems, structural, geotech, facades and sustainability integration.


**Resource management**
* Optimise the deployment of business unit and wider Zutari resources to align with current and future project demands.
* Ensure effective resourcing decisions across priorities, skills, capacity, and budget constraints.
* Build operational capability by supporting recruitment, succession planning, and technical development within the Built Environment team.
* Ensure staff are equipped with the training, tools, and support required to deliver high\-quality work in a fast\-paced MENA environment.
* Foster multidisciplinary collaboration across all internal disciplines and external project and client teams.


**Operational management**
* Oversee day\-to\-day operations of the Built Environment business, including project delivery oversight, utilisation, workforce planning, quality management, and budget performance.
* Establish, track, and report on KPIs to drive operational excellence and accountability.
* Provide guidance on opportunity management, bid structuring, delivery models, and partner engagement.
* Implement and uphold technical standards, project governance requirements, and compliance procedures across the business unit.
* Drive consistency in delivery methodologies, design management, and project controls.
* Strengthen operational maturity in relation to design coordination, authority approvals, and complex stakeholder environments typical of the UAE, KSA and wider MENA market.


**Sales and financial performance**
* Support the achievement of sales, revenue, margin, and cash performance targets for the Built Environment business.
* Monitor business and project financial performance, analyse variances, and implement corrective actions where required.
* Support and review scope changes, variation orders, claims positions, and commercial negotiations in conjunction with project leaders.
* Contribute to pipeline conversion by ensuring robust delivery planning, partner strategies, and resourcing confidence at bid stage.
* Help strengthen Zutari’s market position with developers, architects, contractors, public sector entities, asset owners, and regional delivery partners.


**Optimise operations**
* Implement measures that improve value creation, operational efficiency, and profitability across the Built Environment portfolio.
* Identify process improvement opportunities and streamline operational workflows to enhance productivity and delivery consistency.
* Drive lessons learnt, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing across projects and teams.
* Support digitisation and innovation initiatives that improve coordination, reporting, and project outcomes.


**Collaboration and co\-ordination**
* Ensure effective communication and collaboration across business units, sectors, and regional support functions.
* Coordinate seamless integration of multidisciplinary solutions and client offerings.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with strategic partners, key clients, contractors, developers, and relevant industry bodies in the MENA market.
* Work closely with regional leadership to align operational priorities with client strategy, growth plans, and delivery capacity.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related field.
* Professionally registered engineer or eligible for professional registration with a recognised body
* PMP or equivalent project/programme management certification will be advantageous.
* MBA or similar postgraduate business qualification will be advantageous.


**Other Requirements**
* At least 10 years’ proven experience in an operations, project delivery, or business leadership role of a similar nature.
* Demonstrated at least 10 Years experience in Built Environment consulting within the Middle East.
* Strong understanding of the Built Environment market, including multidiscipline engineering services delivery in an LDC scenario.
* Proven experience working with private developers, architects, contractors, government entities, and major institutional clients in the UAE, KSA and wider MENA region.
* Established professional network in the MENA built environment sector.
* Strong experience in leading LDC and multidiscipline large scale project bids.
* Proven leadership and management experience in a professional services environment, with a strong focus on operational efficiency and delivery excellence.
* Strong understanding of client relationship management, client service, and key account development.
* Strong commercial acumen, including project finance, contract risk, variation management, and margin control.
* Proven ability to identify, assess, and manage operational and delivery risk proactively.
* Excellent leadership and interpersonal skills, with the ability to inspire, guide, and motivate multidisciplinary teams.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to use data and operational metrics to support strategic decision\-making.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic would be advantageous.
* Ability to adapt to changing client needs, market dynamics, and delivery environments across MENA.


***We believe that a diverse workforce is key to our business success. We seek the best people for our jobs based on their skills, qualifications, and experience. We embrace the principle of equal opportunity in employment, and we work towards eliminating all forms of unlawful discrimination in our employ.***

data.jd_text:
Join the UAE’s largest bank and one of the world’s largest and safest financial institutions. Our focus is to create value for our employees, customers, shareholders and communities to grow through differentiation, agility and innovation. We are looking for top talent and your success is our success. Accelerate your growth as you help us reach our goals and advance your career. Be ready to make your mark a top company, in an exciting \& dynamic industry.
 



  





**Job Purpose**




  





 To grow and manage large account portfolios and sensitive client relationships for assigned portfolio in the Real Estate \& Hospitality banking segment; improve service quality levels and supervise the subordinates' day\-to\-day activities and client interactions to ensure that the team's objectives are constantly met and its revenue targets achieved, while maintaining client satisfaction and portfolio credit quality.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities**




  





**Client and Market Analysis** 




  




* Conduct financial analysis on clients and their respective geographies/ industries/ markets to identify potential opportunities and risks.
* Demonstrate understanding of the sector across all RE asset classes
* Originate new business opportunities with new to bank target clients across banking products and in line with relevant policies.
* Cross collaborate to obtain support from relevant stakeholders and governance forums to close deals (e.g., credit, products, GT).
* Develop Term Sheet, Information Memorandum, Mandate letter etc.
* Examine \& resolve credit, market and operational risk aspects of the transactions in collaboration with products and enablement units.
* Leverage FAB’s network expansion through cross border deals to expand RE market share
* Anchor Strategic Alliances with UAE’s Top Developers, Authorities, and sector experts
* Expand Products Penetration Through Sector\-Focused Solutions, keeping with RE cycles and thematics
* Ensure high returns with satisfactory yields
* Maintain the credit quality of the client's relationships within the Portfolio to an acceptable level set by the
* Bank's management.
* Pitch, review, negotiate and conclude deals.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key decision makers in other banks and attend industry events to originate business.
* Up to date with the latest market, competitors, regulatory and industry and amend accordingly the account plans as when applicable.
* Ability to handle sophisticated transactions and engage assigned team members.
* Recommend policy amendments as when required to match with the latest business trends.



  





**Business Origination** 




**Client Relationship Management** 




  




* To achieve assigned financial and non\-financial objectives by meeting all borrowing \& non borrowing needs of customers with target segments (E.g., borrowers, transactors, depositors).
* Prepare and Maintain Account Plans for all clients with support from relevant partners (e.g., products, international banking, Employee banking, Asset Management, etc.).
* Support on the conduct of annual/periodic credit facility reviews in the existing portfolio in a timely manner and support on the recommendation of appropriate credit facilities in line with the banks credit. policy to maximize earnings while containing risks to an acceptable level and identifying candidates for downgrades/ upgrades.
* Develop, Implement and maintain complete control aspects i.e., documentation, periodical client visits / call reports, stock inspections and formal credit checks / informal market feedback to monitor the assigned portfolio effectively.
* Establish appropriate monitoring of client relationships and the underlying RE portfolio performance
* Organize client meetings with relevant partners/ seniority to deepen FAB relationship within the portfolio.
* Identify \& develop cross selling opportunities and increase cross\-sell ratio and returns with clients.
* Support client on their day\-to\-day banking requirements with support from the team (as applicable).
* Ensure customer satisfaction remains high and meets the targeted NPS score.
* Keep abreast of market trends and manage a disciplined marketing process by identifying steps/strategies necessary to effectively initiate relationships with prospects.
* Onboard new clients as and when required.



  





**Collaboration** 




  




* Align with the relevant Real Estate teams across the bank (credit, products) as well as other partners (international FAB offices) to identify and convert opportunities.
* Collaborate with other business divisions to drive cross\-BU collaboration. Develop proposition strategy, competition analysis, focused group approach, service delivery model, customer experience, internal \& external campaigns and alignment with other Products \& proposition including Risk policies, Payment \& Cash management, Trade products, collaboration with Retail banking including Private Banking, etc.
* Align with International banking to support client in FAB network locations.
* Support Unit/Divisional/Bank\-wide initiatives (as required or assigned).



  





**Operational** 




  




* Follow all relevant policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions so that work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner.
* Conduct periodic reviews of risks (credit, operational, compliance etc.) within the portfolio on a regular basis.
* Drive day\-to\-day administrative and transactional activities for the team such as client calls, documentation follow up, pipeline updates, and any other activities in the unit/team to ensure continuity of work and delivery of effective/high quality output.
* Ensure that internal processes for existing portfolio/ NTBs are in\-line with the Bank's policies \& procedures.
* Manage and follow up on KYC and compliance requirements to ensure consistency with the Bank's KYC and AML policies and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure all credit reviews are submitted on time and agreed conditions are met.
* Ensure all clients' files \[documents] are maintained.
* Maintain a satisfactory audit on the portfolio.
* Adhere to process KPl's and, ORM, BCP \& Internal Audit requirements.
* Prepare timely and accurate statements and reports to meet the unit's requirements, policies, and standards.



  





**Leadership** 



* Act as Role Model for the entire Real Estate \& Hospitality group and Real Estate team
* Lead, Mentor, Motivate, Develop and Coach team members to ensure career growth and short \& long term successors
* Establish high\-performance culture and ensure high engagement levels.
* Encourage ownership through rightful assignments to team members.
* Achieve individual and team's financial performance targets.
* Learning \& Development Attend appropriate on and off\-the\-job training programs and ensure development and skill upgradation of team members.
* Involvement in team members new hirings.



  





**Qualifications**




  




* Bachelor’s degree in finance or related discipline.
* Master’s degree in business administration is preferred.



  





**Experience**

data.jd_text:
**Description**
 Amazon Now is building the future of ultra\-fast grocery delivery across the Middle East. We are looking for a Program Manager to drive measurable improvements across store capacity management, cost\-per\-order reduction, and delivery speed (Click\-to\-Door).
   

  

 This role sits within the Operations Excellence function and is responsible for identifying, scoping, and delivering high\-impact programmes that improve customer experience and unit economics across Amazon Now’s network in Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 You will work across Last Mile, Middle Mile, and Under\-The\-Roof (UTR) operations to find inefficiencies, build the business case, and drive cross\-functional execution. This is not a reactive role, you will proactively identify opportunities before they become problems, connect the dots across operational channels, and ensure every initiative ladders up to CX outcomes and P\&L impact.
   

  

 The right candidate is analytically sharp, comfortable with ambiguity, and operates with a bias for action. You think in systems, not silos. You’re as comfortable in the data as you are in a room with senior stakeholders making the case for change.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Store Capacity \& Cost Management
   

  

* Own programmes to optimise store capacity utilization, including bin density, ASIN rationalisation, gas tank management, and space allocation across darkstores.
* Drive cost\-per\-order reduction across the end\-to\-end operation: UTR pick efficiency, DA (Delivery Associate) productivity, hub\-to\-store transhipment costs, and middle mile truck utilisation.
* Analyse operational cost structures to identify the highest\-leverage opportunities for unit economics improvement. Build business cases with clear ROI and execution plans.
* Partner with UTR, Last Mile, and Middle Mile teams to implement changes that reduce waste, improve throughput, and lower cost\-to\-serve without degrading customer experience.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting mechanisms to track capacity utilisation and cost metrics across KSA stores.


 Delivery Speed \& Click\-to\-Door (C2D)
   

  

* Own the programme roadmap for C2D reduction, identifying bottlenecks across order acceptance, pick \& pack, dispatch, and last mile delivery.
* Analyse delivery defects, early delivery marking, Did\-Not\-Receive (DNR) patterns, and other CX pain points to drive root cause resolution.
* Identify and eliminate handoff delays between UTR, Middle Mile, and Last Mile that contribute to C2D inflation.


 Project \& Programme Delivery
   

  

* Scope, plan, and execute operational improvement projects end\-to\-end, from opportunity identification through to measurable business impact.
* Build and manage a portfolio of initiatives across capacity, cost, and speed, with clear prioritisation based on CX and P\&L impact.
* Create mechanisms for project tracking, stakeholder communication, and escalation. Maintain a clear view of project status, risks, and dependencies.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment with ACES, Tech, Finance, Category, and operations teams to remove blockers and deliver on commitments.
* Contribute to the development of scalable solutions that can be replicated across KSA stores, solve once, scale everywhere.


 Cross\-Functional Influence \& Visibility
   

  

* Operate as the connective tissue between operational channels, ensuring improvements in one area don’t create problems in another.
* Build visibility into operational performance through data, dashboards, and regular reporting cadences (WBR/MBR contributions).
* Influence without authority, drive outcomes through data\-backed recommendations, clear communication, and stakeholder management.
* Support Automation \& AI initiatives that drive efficiency, reduce manual effort, and improve decision\-making across operations.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Master's degree
* Experience in program requirements definition, together with data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 5\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL

data.jd_text:
Job Title: Advanced Technology Program Manager (1 Position)
   

  

 About the Job
   

 We are seeking a proactive, highly organized Advanced Technology Program Manager to lead the planning, coordination, and delivery of strategic initiatives across emerging technology domains. The successful candidate will manage research, concept development, and program delivery for projects that explore innovative applications of advanced technologies and translate complex ideas into practical, scalable, and impactful outcomes. This is a hands\-on role working closely with product, engineering, research, partner institutions, and the communications team to build intellectually rigorous, well\-coordinated, and future\-focused programs and initiatives.
   

  

 Responsibilities
   

  

 Lead research and concept development for programs and initiatives involving advanced technologies.
   

  

 Identify, commission, and cultivate relationships with technologists, researchers, product teams, strategic partners, and external collaborators.
   

  

 Produce program briefs, technical notes, project summaries, reports, and supporting materials that communicate complex topics clearly.
   

  

 Develop project timelines, delivery briefs, and coordinate implementation with technical teams and vendors.
   

  

 Manage project budgets, schedules, and supplier / contractor relationships.
   

  

 Organize accompanying workshops, demos, training sessions, and educational materials.
   

  

 Liaise with technical and business partners to ensure accurate, ethical, and effective delivery of initiatives; arrange access to data, prototypes, or environments as required.
   

  

 Oversee documentation, testing records, and archival notes for each project or initiative.
   

  

 Support fundraising and proposal applications by preparing research summaries and recommendations.
   

  

 Monitor stakeholder feedback and research impact; refine strategies to increase accessibility, adoption, and engagement.
   

  

 Qualifications
   

  

 Minimum BA/MA in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Data Science, Information Systems, Product Management, or a related field; PhD or equivalent research experience preferred.
   

  

 At least 3–5 years of experience in advanced technology, innovation, research, consulting, program management, or an equivalent professional setting.
   

  

 Demonstrable interest in and familiarity with advanced technology topics such as artificial intelligence, blockchain, IoT, extended reality, digital innovation, or related frontier domains — deep technical expertise is not required, but proven ability to learn and collaborate with technical teams is essential.
   

  

 Strong research, writing, and editorial skills — able to produce clear, engaging technical and business\-facing texts and funding materials.
   

  

 Project management experience: budgets, timelines, supplier coordination, and logistics.
   

  

 Excellent interpersonal skills and experience building cross\-disciplinary collaborations between product, engineering, research, and business teams.
   

  

 Experience programming workshops, demos, training sessions, or education activities.
   

  

 Commitment to accessible presentation and ethical engagement with technology content.
   

  

 Portfolio or track record of technology programs, initiatives, prototypes, or related work (links or PDF).
   

  

 Fluency in English; additional languages an asset.
   

  

 What We Offer
   

  

 The opportunity to shape a high\-visibility, interdisciplinary advanced technology program.
   

  

 A collaborative team of designers, producers, researchers, and communications specialists.
   

  

 Competitive compensation and project\-related resources (production budget, research funds).
   

  

 Support for travel and research visits to partner teams and institutions.
   

  

 Professional development and publication opportunities.
   

  

 How to Apply
   

 Please submit the following to farhang@parsikia.ir with subject line “Advanced Technology Program Manager”:
   

  

 1\. CV (max 2 pages)
   

  

 2\. Cover letter (1 page) describing relevant experience and why you’re excited about advanced technology program management
   

  

 3\. Portfolio or links to 3 relevant projects (PDF or URL)
   

  

 4\. Two references (name, role, contact)
   

  

 Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an interview and asked to present a brief advanced technology concept (written \+ 5\-slide summary). We welcome applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds and encourage cross\-disciplinary practitioners to apply.

data.jd_text:
一、岗位职责
 



 1\. 交易系统基础设施与稳定性保障
 



 \- 负责公司核心交易系统（现货/合约/衍生品/撮合引擎）的整体运维架构与稳定性保障
 



 \- 建立7x24小时高可用运维体系，确保交易系统低延迟、高吞吐与零宕机目标
 



 \- 设计并优化多活/容灾/异地双活架构，保障极端行情下系统稳定运行
 



 2\. 高并发与低延迟架构支持
 



 \- 支撑高频交易与极端行情流量洪峰（行情波动、插针行情、黑天鹅事件等）
 



 \- 优化网络链路、撮合系统、行情系统及API网关性能
 



 \- 持续降低系统延迟（Latency Optimization）与提升系统吞吐能力
 



 3\. 云基础设施与全球化部署
 



 \- 负责全球多机房、多地域云资源架构设计与统一管理（AWS / GCP / 阿里云等）
 



 \- 推动全球节点部署（亚太、欧美等）与跨境网络优化
 



 \- 优化云资源成本结构与资源利用率
 



 4\. 运维体系与自动化建设（SRE/DevOps）
 



 \- 建设标准化SRE体系，包括监控、告警、发布、变更、回滚机制
 



 \- 推动全链路自动化运维（CI/CD、自动扩缩容、自动故障自愈）
 



 \- 建设统一监控体系（Metrics/Logs/Tracing）与AIOps能力
 



 5\. 安全与风控支撑
 



 \- 建立基础设施安全体系（权限管理、访问控制、漏洞管理、DDoS防护）
 



 \- 配合安全团队构建交易安全与资金安全防护体系
 



 \- 支撑风控系统稳定运行（异常交易监控、风险引擎稳定性保障）
 



 6\. 重大故障与应急管理
 



 \- 负责重大线上事故的应急响应、根因分析（RCA）及复盘机制
 



 \- 建立事故分级响应机制（P0/P1/P2）及演练体系
 



 \- 提升整体MTTR（平均恢复时间）与系统可用性指标
 



 7\. 团队管理与组织建设
 



 \- 管理SRE/系统/网络/安全/DBA等运维团队
 



 \- 建立技术梯队与绩效体系，提升团队工程能力
 



 \- 支撑公司全球化业务扩展与组织规模增长
 



 8\. 跨部门协同
 



 \- 与研发、产品、交易系统、风控、安全等团队紧密协作
 



 \- 支撑交易系统快速迭代与业务上线节奏
 



 \- 参与关键技术架构评审与系统设计决策
 



 二、任职要求
 



 1\. 经验背景
 



 \- 本科及以上学历，计算机、网络、通信等相关专业优先
 



 \- 8年以上运维/基础架构/SRE经验，其中至少3年以上团队管理经验
 



 \- 有交易所 / 数字货币 / 金融交易系统 / 高并发系统经验优先
 



 2\. 核心技术能力
 



 \- 熟悉Linux系统、网络架构（TCP/IP、BGP、CDN等）
 



 \- 熟悉分布式系统架构、微服务架构及中间件（Kafka/Redis/MySQL等）
 



 \- 熟悉云平台（AWS/GCP/AliCloud）及Kubernetes容器化体系
 



 \- 具备大型系统性能调优与故障排查能力
 



 3\. 行业能力（关键）
 



 \- 理解交易系统架构（撮合引擎、订单系统、行情系统、钱包系统）
 



 \- 熟悉高频交易、低延迟系统设计优先
 



 \- 有应对极端行情（暴涨暴跌）系统稳定性经验
 



 4\. 管理能力
 



 \- 能管理50人以上运维团队
 



 \- 有较强跨部门推动能力（研发/产品/风控/安全）
 



 \- 能建立制度化、流程化运维体系
 



 5\. 软性要求
 



 \- 极强抗压能力（7x24事故响应场景）
 



 \- 结果导向，逻辑清晰，决策能力强
 



 \- 能适应全球化业务节奏与时区协作
 



 三、加分项
 



 \- 有交易所或Web3基础设施经验
 



 \- 有撮合系统/高频交易系统运维经验
 



 \- 有0→1搭建SRE体系经验
 


* \- 有多活容灾/全球节点架构经验

**About Cushman \&Wakefield** 




 In today’s world, where and how you work is critical for success. Real estate is no longer just focused on footprint and costs\- but delivering strategic outcomes for organizations. That is why we partner with you to craft a tailored approach that aligns with your unique goals and meets the needs and preferences of your employees.
 



  





 Operating across 400 offices in 60 countries, we collaborate with the industry’s top professionals, and we are supported by leading technology and research to ensure consistent results. We build enduring relationships by making our team an extension of your business—aligned with your goals and committed to maximizing bottom\-line performance.
 



  





**Job Summary** 




 We are seeking a driven and experienced Associate Director to lead the delivery of Corporate Services and Global Occupier Solutions (GOS) within our newly established Project Development Services division at Cushman \& Wakefield Core. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in corporate fit\-out, with a proven track record delivering for blue\-chip occupiers.
 



  





**What We Look For** 




**Responsibilities of the role:** 



* Lead and manage corporate occupier and fit\-out projects from inception to completion, ensuring high\-quality delivery within budget and timelines.
* Serve as a key client interface, developing trusted relationships with global and regional occupier clients.
* Develop and implement the business strategy for the sector, aligning with overall company objectives and market trends.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a point of contact for assigned accounts
* Collaborate with internal teams, both local and international, to drive integrated service delivery.
* Identify and pursue new business opportunities to grow the GOS/Corporate Services/Fit\-Out client base.
* Manage and mentor project teams and consultants, ensuring excellence in service and professional development.
* Provide expert advice throughout the project lifecycle, from initial feasibility studies to project completion.
* Contribute to departmental strategy, operational planning, management and reporting.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Minimum 8\-10 years of experience in the corporate fit\-out sector, ideally within a project management consultancy, or as a projectleader for a contractor specializing in commercial interiors.
* Demonstrated experience managing high\-quality office fit\-outs, workplace transformations, and tenant improvement projects in the UAE or wider GCC.
* Bachelor’s degree in Project Management, Quantity Surveying, Construction, Architecture, Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong leadership and client\-facing skills with the ability to manage stakeholders and multidisciplinary teams.
* RICS, PMP, or equivalent project management certification is a plus.



  





**Experience** 



* Proven track record of successfully delivering medium to large scale fit out projects
* Experience of team management and mentoring juniorstaff
* Strong communication and interpersonal skillswith ability to build strongclient relationships
* Analytical and problem\-solving skillswith attention to detail
* Highly proficient with Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and industry relevant software
* Knowledge of relevant industry standards, contracts and regulations
* Detail\-oriented and able to manage multiple tasks efficiently.
* Excellent command of English, both written and spoken
* Knowledge of Arabic language preferred but not essential



  





**Why Join Us?** 




 At Cushman\& Wakefield Core, you’ll be part of a global platform with a strong local presence. This role offers the chance to build a critical function within a growing division, work with high\-profile occupiers, and influence the way world\-class workplaces are delivered across the region.
 



  





**Additional Information** 




 At Cushman\& Wakefield Core, we embrace diversity and inclusion, and we strive to create a collaborative working environment and a community supporting your career growth.
