data.jd_text:
At Genius we are hiring for a role of
 **Manager Operations\-\-Home Delivery** 
 for a leading FMCG client
 



**Location Dubai** 




 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Delivery Operations Management
 


* Oversee and manage end\-to\-end delivery operations across all outlets and brands.
* Ensure compliance with company standards, food safety regulations, and operational procedures.
* Maintain delivery infrastructure readiness, including staffing, systems, packaging, and logistics processes.
* Monitor and improve operational KPIs including SLA adherence, delivery delays, cancellations, refunds, customer ratings, and order accuracy.
* Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks in coordination with outlet management teams.
* Conduct regular operational audits to ensure consistency and service excellence.



 2\. Aggregator \& Partner Management
 


* Manage relationships with third\-party delivery aggregators and logistics partners.
* Negotiate commercial terms, commissions, service level agreements (SLAs), and partnership conditions.
* Monitor promotional campaigns, marketing activities, and platform visibility.
* Optimize advertising spend, discount structures, and promotional ROI.
* Ensure partner compliance and resolve operational or technical issues promptly.



 3\. Sales, Marketing \& Growth
 


* Drive delivery sales growth and profitability across all brands and markets.
* Plan and execute delivery\-focused marketing campaigns and promotional activities.
* Analyze campaign performance and implement strategies to maximize ROI.
* Support the development and expansion of dark kitchens and virtual brands.
* Optimize menu engineering, pricing strategies, and product availability to maximize revenue.



 4\. Customer Experience Management
 


* Manage and resolve escalated customer complaints related to delivery operations.
* Monitor customer feedback trends and implement continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure accurate documentation, tracking, and resolution of customer feedback and service issues.
* Maintain high customer satisfaction and service quality standards.



 5\. Reporting \& Analytics
 


* Prepare and present daily, weekly, and monthly operational and commercial reports.
* Analyze sales performance, delivery KPIs, customer behavior, and operational trends.
* Provide actionable insights and recommendations to senior management for business improvement.
* Develop dashboards and performance tracking mechanisms to support data\-driven decision\-making.



 6\. Compliance \& Quality Assurance
 


* Ensure adherence to company policies, operational standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Conduct regular audits and compliance checks across all delivery operations.
* Maintain and improve quality assurance processes to ensure consistent service standards.



 7\. Contract Management
 


* Manage contracts and agreements with delivery aggregators, logistics providers, and external partners.
* Track contract renewals, compliance obligations, and commercial performance.
* Ensure all agreements align with company objectives and operational requirements.



 8\. Strategic Planning \& Expansion
 


* Support new outlet openings, market expansions, and brand launches.
* Conduct feasibility studies and operational assessments for new delivery initiatives.
* Identify opportunities for operational efficiency, automation, and continuous improvement.
* Contribute to long\-term delivery growth strategies and business development initiatives.



 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 


* Delivery sales and order growth
* SLA and delivery time adherence
* Customer satisfaction and ratings
* Order accuracy and cancellation rates
* Refund and complaint reduction
* Cost control and operational efficiency
* Campaign performance and ROI
* Aggregator relationship performance
* Profitability of delivery operations



 Qualifications \& Requirements
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Hospitality, or a related field.
* Minimum 10\+ years of experience in delivery operations, food service, QSR, or multi\-unit operations management.
* Strong understanding of delivery aggregators, food delivery platforms, and logistics operations.
* Proven experience in KPI management, sales growth, and operational optimization.
* Strong analytical, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Proficiency in reporting tools, Microsoft Excel, and operational dashboards.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, multi\-market environment.

Müller's Solutions is seeking an experienced and results\-driven
 **ServiceNow Service Delivery Manager** 
 to oversee the delivery and performance of our ServiceNow solutions. In this role, you will be responsible for managing service delivery teams, ensuring alignment with business goals, and driving continuous improvement in ServiceNow platform operations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
 Take full responsibility for the overall delivery of the ServiceNow platform services, encompassing:
   

  

* Continuous operations and support, ensuring the platform is always available, reliable, and performing optimally to meet organizational needs
* Enhancements driven by the backlog, prioritizing and implementing improvements and new features that align with business objectives and user feedback
* Coordination of releases and deployments, managing schedules, resources, and communication to guarantee smooth transitions and minimal disruption


 Serve as the main escalation point and decision\-maker for delivery\-related issues, ensuring that:
   

  

* Problems are resolved quickly through effective troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and engagement with relevant teams
* Risks are effectively controlled by proactively identifying potential issues and implementing mitigation strategies
* Delivery obligations are fulfilled in accordance with agreed timelines, quality standards, and contract requirements


 Collaborate closely with stakeholders to:
   

  

* Comprehend and prioritize demands, balancing competing needs to deliver maximum value to the organization
* Question and verify requirements when necessary, ensuring clarity, feasibility, and alignment with strategic goals
* Guarantee alignment between business objectives and platform capabilities, facilitating seamless integration and optimal use of ServiceNow features


 Provide strong leadership to the delivery teams, which include:
   

  

* Technical consultants and developers, guiding them to apply best practices, innovate, and maintain high code quality
* Business analysts, supporting requirement gathering, documentation, and communication between business and technical teams
* QA and support personnel, ensuring thorough testing, issue identification, and responsive support services


 Lead delivery governance and uphold standards, ensuring:
   

  

* Consistent development practices that adhere to organizational policies and industry standards
* Controlled release processes that minimize risk, ensure quality, and provide clear documentation
* Alignment to platform design and reuse principles, promoting efficient, maintainable, and scalable solutions


 Ensure quality and accountability across delivery, including:
   

  

* Reviewing progress against commitments, conducting regular status meetings and reporting to stakeholders
* Monitoring delivery KPIs and SLAs, analyzing performance data to identify trends and areas for improvement
* Supporting issue resolution and performance improvement initiatives to enhance service quality and customer satisfaction


 Act as a trusted point of contact for stakeholders, capable of:
   

  

* Representing technical and functional decisions clearly and effectively, bridging communication between business and IT teams
* Managing expectations and resolving conflicts diplomatically to maintain positive relationships and project momentum
* Standing behind delivery teams with confidence, advocating for resources, and providing guidance to overcome challenges


 Support continuous improvement of service delivery, including:
   

  

* Identifying inefficiencies and bottlenecks through regular process reviews and feedback collection
* Driving optimisation of processes and workflows to increase efficiency, reduce costs, and improve user experience
* Promoting effective use of ServiceNow capabilities by encouraging adoption of new features, best practices, and ongoing training


**Requirements**
**7 to 10\+ years of experience in Service Delivery, with extensive knowledge of ServiceNow**
**platforms, including:**
* In\-depth understanding of various ServiceNow modules and features such as:
+ ITSM
+ ITOM / CMDB
+ HRSD / enterprise services
+ CSM


**Capable of:**
* Confidently engaging with both technical teams and business stakeholders
* Critically evaluating requirements and assumptions when necessary
* Converting high\-level requirements into actionable delivery strategies


**Demonstrated experience in managing:**
* Multiple ServiceNow delivery streams, including operations and enhancements
* Backlog\-driven development prioritization
* Cross\-functional teams


**Strong knowledge of:**
* Service delivery models and governance frameworks
* Management of SLAs and KPIs
* Release and change management procedures


**Ability to:**
* Assertively participate in stakeholder discussions and justify delivery decisions
* Effectively support and represent delivery teams
* Maintain control in complex or high\-pressure situations


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* ITIL Foundation or higher certification
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator or other relevant certifications
* Experience working with Agile methodologies and project management tools
* Familiarity with automation and workflow optimization within the ServiceNow platform


**Benefits**
 1\- Attractive Package.
   

  

 2\- Family Benefits.
   

  

 3\- Visa.
   

  

 4\-Air Tickets.

**About IC Markets** 




 IC Markets Global is one of the most renowned Forex CFD provider, offering trading solutions for active day traders and scalpers as well as traders that are new to the forex market. IC Markets Global offers its clients cutting edge trading platforms, low latency connectivity and superior liquidity.
 



 IC Markets Global is revolutionizing online forex trading. Traders are now able to gain access to pricing previously only available to investment banks and high net worth individuals.
 



 Our management team have significant experience in the Forex, CFD and Equity markets in Asia, Europe and North America. It is this experience that has enabled us to select the best possible technology solutions and hand pick some of the best pricing providers available in the market.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 We are seeking an experienced Technical Delivery Manager to lead the end\-to\-end delivery of complex, high\-impact programmes across multiple engineering teams. This senior role is the critical connective layer between engineering, product, architecture, and leadership. responsible for resolving cross\-team dependencies, driving delivery of intricate technical projects, and ensuring predictable, high\-quality outcomes at scale. The ideal candidate brings deep technical fluency combined with exceptional programme management skills, and thrives in navigating ambiguity across distributed, multi\-disciplinary teams within a regulated fintech environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Cross\-Team Dependency \& Complex Delivery Management** 



* Own and drive resolution of cross\-team technical dependencies across 8–12\+ engineering squads
* Establish and maintain programme\-level dependency maps, risk registers, and escalation paths
* Lead planning and execution of complex, multi\-team deliveries spanning months or multiple quarters
* Identify inter\-team blockers early and orchestrate timely resolution with engineering leads and architects
* Coordinate integration milestones, shared API contracts, and platform\-level dependencies across squads



  





**Delivery \& Release Governance** 



* Define and enforce delivery governance frameworks for large\-scale technical programmes
* Ensure production readiness through structured release checkpoints, go/no\-go criteria, and sign\-off processes
* Oversee end\-to\-end release management across parallel workstreams, coordinating across QA, DevOps, and Platform teams
* Monitor programme health, critical path, and execution risks; escalate proactively to leadership
* Drive standardization of release and deployment governance across the engineering organization



  





**Technical Programme Leadership** 



* Partner with Engineering Leads, Principal Engineers, and Architects to translate technical strategy into actionable delivery plans
* Lead structured programme ceremonies: dependency syncs, architecture reviews, cross\-team planning, and programme\-level retrospectives
* Maintain and evolve Agile and hybrid delivery frameworks tailored to programme complexity and team maturity
* Drive PI Planning and large\-scale increment coordination across product and platform squads



  





**Stakeholder \& Executive Engagement** 



* Serve as the primary delivery interface for senior stakeholders, CTO, and executive leadership on complex programmes
* Produce clear, data\-driven programme status reports, risk dashboards, and delivery forecasts for leadership review
* Translate complex technical interdependencies into business\-level impact narratives for non\-technical audiences
* Proactively manage expectations, surface trade\-offs, and recommend delivery options under constraint.



  





**Tooling \& Delivery Intelligence** 



* Own and evolve programme\-level Jira structures including epics hierarchies, dependency links, cross\-project boards, and automation
* Drive delivery intelligence through advanced metrics: cycle time, lead time, flow efficiency, dependency resolution SLAs.
* Build and maintain executive\-level dashboards that surface programme health, risk, and delivery confidence
* Ensure tooling practices support audit readiness and compliance requirements in a regulated financial services environment



  





**Qualifications \& Experience:** 



* 10\+ years in Technical Delivery Management, Programme Management, or Engineering Leadership roles
* Proven track record delivering complex, multi\-team technical programmes in a regulated or high\-stakes environment
* Deep expertise in cross\-team dependency management across large engineering organizations (8\+ teams)
* Strong technical fluency; ability to engage credibly with engineers, architects, and platform teams on technical trade\-offs
* Extensive experience with Agile at scale frameworks and hybrid delivery models
* Advanced Jira administration, programme\-level workflow design, and delivery metrics expertise
* Proven experience driving complex release governance across distributed, parallel workstreams
* Experience working in fintech, trading platforms, or high\-frequency, regulated product environments strongly preferred
* Exceptional stakeholder management and executive communication skills
* Comfortable operating with ambiguity and driving clarity in a fast\-paced, high\-complexity environment

Job description:
   

  

 Purpose of the Job
 
 The Senior Director of Industrial Engineering \& Network Design is a pivotal leadership role responsible for transforming Aramex’s regional operating model. This position spearheads initiatives to enhance efficiency, scalability, and financial optimization across multiple operational geographies, ensuring the network meets the demands of a dynamic logistics landscape.
 


* Drive the strategic design and execution of innovative operating models tailored to regional challenges and opportunities.
* Develop comprehensive cost frameworks integrating fixed, variable, and semi\-variable expenditures for transparent financial management.
* Deliver actionable insights through full transparency of productivity and performance metrics across the operational footprint.


 Job Description
 * Lead a comprehensive evaluation and redesign of Aramex’s regional operating model, defining clear roles and interfaces for hubs, facilities, and last\-mile operations to optimize service delivery and network integration.
* Establish and implement standardized engineering and operational processes designed to modernize current workflows, enhance consistency, and promote best practices region\-wide.
* Create and enforce robust governance structures that unify operational methodologies, ensuring harmonized practices and improved collaboration across diverse markets.
* Design and refine the fixed, variable, and semi\-variable cost model to accurately allocate expenses and identify clear levers for cost optimization and financial performance enhancement.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive operational productivity metrics alongside dynamic performance dashboards to provide real\-time visibility and facilitate data\-driven decision\-making.
* Champion strategic initiatives aimed at reducing cost\-to\-serve and enhancing cost\-per\-piece metrics by leveraging engineering insights and operational analytics.
* Define and enforce engineering standards for network planning inclusive of facility productivity targets, resource allocation strategies, and load/capacity modeling to maximize operational efficiencies.
* Support operational teams through process redesigns, load capacity charts, and engineering\-backed performance planning tools that enable proactive resource and workflow management.
* Leverage data\-driven scenario simulations and productivity analyses to underpin critical business decisions, promoting transparency and objective evaluation.
* Lead cultural transformation efforts to transition legacy operational mindsets towards agile, adaptive, and performance\-focused behavioral models that align with strategic objectives.
* Exert influence and mobilize cross\-functional, multi\-country teams by building strong relationships, advocating for change, and fostering commitment to new operating principles without direct line authority.
* Communicate vision, progress, and outcomes of transformation initiatives clearly and consistently to stakeholders at regional and country levels to ensure alignment and sustained engagement.


 Job Requirements \- Experience and Education
 * Bachelor's degree in Engineering is essential; master's level or higher qualifications in Engineering, Supply Chain, or related fields are preferred to demonstrate advanced expertise.
* Over 15 years of progressive experience in designing, implementing, or transforming operational and engineering models within logistics, transportation, or network\-centric industries.
* Proven track record working in complex, multi\-country environments, managing diverse teams and navigating regional regulatory and market nuances effectively.
* Deep expertise in operating model development, engineering planning disciplines, and continuous process improvement strategies within large\-scale operations.
* Strong financial literacy with demonstrated experience building detailed cost frameworks, enabling sound budgeting, forecasting, and cost optimization initiatives.
* Competency in developing and deploying KPI frameworks, productivity measurement models, and integrated performance dashboards that support operational excellence.
* Demonstrated success in leading large\-scale change management and transformational initiatives with the ability to align diverse stakeholders and drive adoption.
* Exceptional influencing and interpersonal skills, capable of guiding cross\-functional teams across regions without direct hierarchical control.

 Skills

**Job Purpose**
 At Emirates IT, we are dedicated to staying ahead of the curve by embracing the latest technologies and strategies to streamline integration processes and enhance infrastructure efficiency. As a valued member of our team, you will play a pivotal role in managing and optimizing our integration landscape, ensuring smooth data flow and system interoperability across our enterprise platforms. If you are passionate about creating seamless integration solutions and driving technological excellence, we invite you to apply and to contribute to the success of Emirates Group.
   

  

 Join our Agile Delivery team on a mission to create technology solutions that enhance customer experience and drive revenue growth. We focus on leveraging agile methodologies to deliver innovative and secure technology quickly and efficiently. If you are passionate about delivering value, embracing agility, and leading projects in a dynamic environment, we invite you to apply and become a key player in our journey to drive success at the Emirates Group.
   

  

**The** 
**Agile Delivery Manager** 
**is responsible for planning, leading, organising and motivating scrum teams, either within a Release Train or outside, to achieve a high level of performance and quality in the delivery of outputs that provide exceptional value to end users and customers. The Agile Delivery Manager may be responsible for managing several concurrent high visibility initiatives using agile/hybrid methods, in a fast paced environment that may involve multiple business units.**
**In This Role You Will**
* Facilitate key ceremonies such as PI planning and Review, and play a consultative role to help put in place the appropriate people, process, and tools supporting the Agile framework and coaching members of the team as needed to optimize the efficiency of the Release Train team.
* Act as a Champion in blending traditional project management principles and practices with an Agile development approach in the right proportions to fit initiatives of all sizes with the appropriate level of planning and provide the right balance of agility and predictability based on PMI\-ACP principles.
* Build a trusting and safe environment where problems can be raised without fear of blame or retribution, with an emphasis on healing and problem\-solving. Protect and provide all support to the team/s using a servant leadership style whenever possible and lead by example. Facilitate getting the work done practicing servant leadership and encourage discussion, decision making and conflict resolution.
* Lead the Integrated Programme Planning (Lean Start Up). Working with portfolio teams and supporting the Technical Product Manager, drive and facilitate decomposition of Epic Roadmaps into Integrated Program backlog/plans (Features), ready for hand off into team level backlogs.
* Drive Quality and ensure the Definition of Done (DOD) is being followed; ensures each team member is fully engaged in the stories and making a meaningful contribution. Encourage a sustainable pace adhering to the agreed quality management plan with the team. Maintain an agile project management tool (e.g. ScrumDesk, JIRA, etc.).
* Assist in team development through holding teams accountable for their commitments, removing roadblocks to their work; leveraging cross functional team skills to improve product backlog throughput; and mentoring and developing team members. Attend regular stand\-ups and scrum of scrums, in order to understand the team's progress and issues, and to flag up to the team, where necessary, any important external issues of which they need to be aware.
* Supports the Technical Product Manager in managing business expectations and transparency in both product backlog and schedule for all initiatives. Supports IT Service Manager on service management, service performance and continuous improvements.
* Define and manage a well\-defined process and champion ongoing process improvement initiatives to implement best practices for Agile Delivery Management. Implement an agile governance with key ceremonies, drives continuous improvement with constant assessments of velocity (team story point throughput), defect percentage improvements etc. and also ensures that required governance and ceremonies are in place to give visibility and transparency to business stakeholders.
* Assist with the cost estimation / sizing exercise for both near term and future initiatives and assists with preparing total cost of ownership with the product team, maintains the actuals within the allocated budget and also ensure that forecasting for all the demands are accurately done for the FY.
* Together with the Product team, supports the RFx phases in the procurement process and the scheduling of such activities in relation to the product lifecycle.


 Qualification
   

  

**To be considered for the role, you must meet the below requirements:**
* Degree in Computer Science or equivalent
* Proven leadership and project delivery experience in a matrix organisation with global teams for a large organisation.
* Experience in agile delivery within the context of a large technology change programmes.


**Knowledge/skills**
* Certified SAFe and PMI ACP (additional certifications such as PMI, Prince 2, CSM desirable) with 5\+ Years of practical application of the Scrum Management discipline.
* Well\-versed in the use of tools of software delivery e.g. ServiceNow ITBM, MS OFFICE suite, JIRA, Confluence etc.
* Good architectural knowledge of large scale systems.
* Ability to effectively communicate specialist information in an understandable format to all stakeholders.
* Excellent communication skills, focusing on core scrum values of openness, honesty and respect.
* Hands\-on leader with strong people skills.


 Leadership Role: Yes
   

  

 Salary \& benefits
   

  

 Join us in Dubai and enjoy an attractive tax\-free salary and travel benefits that are exclusive to our industry, including discounts on flights and hotel stays around the world. Find out what it’s like to live and work in our fast\-paced, cosmopolitan home city in the Dubai Lifestyle section of our website www.emirates.com/careers

**Responsibilities**
**Technical Leadership \& Design Governance**
* Provide senior technical leadership and act as technical authority, or deputy where appropriate, on rail projects in the UAE and across the Middle East.
* Define and uphold technical standards, design principles and governance processes in line with UAE and regional authority requirements.
* Lead the delivery of multidisciplinary rail design projects as Project Director, Project Manager or Subject Matter Expert, as required.

* Work with Project Directors and discipline leads to support the successful delivery of major rail programmes across the UAE and Middle East.

* Proactively identify technical and integration risks and support mitigation strategies.
* Ensure full compliance with regional and local QHSE requirements.


**People \& Capability Development**

* Support recruitment, succession planning and capability growth to meet the expanding Middle East rail market.

**Qualifications**

* Chartered Engineer status, or the ability to demonstrate progress toward chartership.
* Typically 15 to 18\+ years of experience in rail engineering and rail design consultancy.
* Proven rail project experience in the UAE and/or Middle East, including familiarity with regional authorities, standards and approvals processes.
* Strong multidisciplinary rail background with experience across the full project lifecycle and a track record of rail design and delivery.
* Experience leading bids, proposals, client engagement and business development activities.
* Ability to operate confidently in a client\-facing technical leadership role.
* Strong technical credibility across rail disciplines, with systems\-thinking and problem\-solving capability.
* Strong commercial acumen, with experience supporting bids, client frameworks and market growth.
* Client\-focused, collaborative and credible with senior stakeholders.
* Clear communicator with the ability to influence clients, partners and internal stakeholders.
* Experience working across both regional and international rail programmes, including high\-speed rail, metro and light rail.
* Established relationships with key regional rail clients, authorities or delivery partners would be advantageous.

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**




 To manage the facilities and operations within the assigned portfolio of assets/ buildings while implementing best supplier and customer relationship management, facilities management, building energy services management, maintenance, and contract management practices that improve the overall operational efficiency of managed assets, maintain high customer satisfaction,
 



 and help achieve Enova’s business objectives.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities**



* Provide inputs to the development of the overall division strategy and participate in developing the business unit strategy in line with the vision, mission, and business objectives of the company.
* Deliver the Facilities Management strategy while ensuring contractual commitments are successfully met.
* Manage the effective achievement of the business unit’s objectives through leading the Facilities and Operations team in the assigned project, by setting individual objectives, managing performance, developing and motivating staff, and providing formal and informal feedback and appraisals in order to maximize the subordinates’ and the business unit’s performance.
* Contribute and assist the director of operations in defining an optimum structure for the business unit/ division so that resources are optimally utilized, and communication takes place in an efficient manner.
* Recommend and oversee the budget for the business unit and monitor financial performance versus the budget so that the business is aware of anticipated costs/ revenues, areas of unsatisfactory performance and potential areas of cost reduction are identified, and performance improvement opportunities are realized.
* Lead and manage the Facilities Management function while ensuring the planning and allocation of all resources, and the implementation of the appropriate standards and controls to ensure that all the unit activities are carried out in an efficient and effective manner to meet and exceed unit objectives.
* Discuss “Side\-Specific\-Budgets” with customers including CAPEX for example, advise the customers on expenditures, opportunities for cost reductions, and the viability/ feasibility of changing/ buying assets (such as changing a chiller for example) to ensure customers’ budgeting is as appropriate and as accurate as possible.
* Possesses extensive experience in key utilities, including but not limited to District cooling plants, Domestic water plant and network, Power distribution network, HV/LV substations and good knowledge in SCADA and BMS systems.
* Develop and monitor SLAs for the assets, and ensure that they are aligned to service delivery, client expectations, and expectations from suppliers / service partners in order to achieve quality service delivery, effective supplier relationship management, and profitability.
* Monitor service delivery performance and lead the evaluation of suppliers’ performance to ensure the selection of appropriately qualified service providers at the optimum price in order to deliver the expected quality of service.
* Monitor resource utilization to ensure that the right number and talent is available for running operations as well as minor projects, mechanical \& HVAC works, electrical works, etc.), accomplishing targets, improving customer satisfaction, and achieving business objectives.
* Monitor and control the execution of maintenance contracts, review the preventive and corrective maintenance programs, and supervise the implementation by employees or assigned contractor(s) through reviewing reports and spot\-checking as appropriate to ensure the provision of quality maintenance works to the facilities (including maintenance to equipment, Turbines, Generators, Chillers, HVAC, pumps, sewage lifting stations, substations, infrastructure networks, etc.).
* Attend all coordination meetings with the client.
* Monitor the request for quotations and the preparation of Purchase Orders and Vendor Contracts, approve same, and ensure that the purchasing process is optimized to guarantee the provision of products/ services to the company/ customer on time and avoid any operational delays.
* Ensure that the Annual Leave Planer is completed to have a holistic view on forecasted leaves and employees’ availabilities throughout the year so as to guarantee that the appropriate resourcing is done and that business operations do not get interrupted.
* Manage customers’ expectations through clear communication and transparent work attitude in order to be consistent and to develop strong customer relationships.
* Receive escalated problems and complaints from the Call Centre and ensure that the necessary support and maintenance work is provided to customers in a timely fashion in order to resolve customers’ issues (pertaining to cooling, power interruptions, ventilation, plumbing, etc.) and maintain their high levels of satisfaction.
* Escort customers on daily tours within the premises/ facilities, listen to any feedback or complaints they might have, and delegate any work needed to the subordinates in order to provide customers with the necessary civil, mechanical, electrical, etc. support and maintenance support.
* Provide technical advice to customers and represent customers in technical interfaces with third parties (such as dealing with contractors conducting any construction work on premises while ensuring that they are delivering according to the agreement) as well as furnish customers with technical advice on improvement opportunities (such as reducing utility consumption and bills) in order to increase CSR awareness and contribute in achieving a greener environment.
* Manage the implementation and improvement of policies, guidelines, and processes for contract management and administration to ensure standards are set so that all business requirements are fulfilled while delivering a quality service to customers in line with the corporate strategy.
* Manage the process of revising contracts’ scope of work, renewing the contract while recommending changes, conducting pricing, and negotiating the contract with the customer while coordinating the Terms \& Conditions of the contract with the Legal department to ensure alignment with internal policies and any external laws and regulations.
* Lead and monitor the subcontracting of works (such as fire systems, gas, emergency lighting, vertical transportation, water treatment, tank cleaning, etc.), ensure that subcontractors fulfil their duties in an accurate manner and as per the agreed upon contractual clauses, and manage subcontractors’ evaluations and negotiations while ensuring that chosen subcontractors are approved by the relevant authorities to guarantee compliance with the regulatory framework (such as any approvals needed from the Civil Defense Department for fire\-fighting systems)
* Ensure effective planning and implementation of HSEEQ inspections and audits in order to meet regulatory requirements and company standards.
* Monitor physical and documentation audits being conducted on subcontractors to ensure that work is being conducted properly and that customers are being served with the highest quality standards, and take the necessary actions upon the detection of unreported/ undisclosed variations and/ or poor performance to safeguard the company against any liabilities.
* Lead the audits of staff, customers, and suppliers to gather feedback and monitor satisfaction in order to improve the operations and facilities management services Enova provides.
* Develop and ensure the implementation of division policies, procedures, and controls covering all areas of activity so that all relevant procedural/ legislative requirements are fulfilled while delivering a quality and cost\-effective service.
* Ensure compliance to all relevant quality, health, safety, and environmental management policies, procedures, and controls across the department to guarantee employee safety, legislative compliance, delivery of high quality products/ service and a responsible environmental attitude.
* Ensure corrective actions and preventive actions issued by the HSEEQ department are implemented, update the HSEEQ department about the progress of the implementation
* Ensure the legionella reporting is timely sent to HSEEQ department
* Ensure the HIRAs are finalized and yearly updated, with support of the HSEQ department
* Ensure the risk control measures arising from the HIRA are properly implemented
* Ensure availability of MS and RA for outsourced works
* Ensure relevant emergency tests are conducted
* Ensure that all departmental reports are prepared timely and accurately and meet requirements, policies, and standards.
* Perform other related duties or assignments as directed



  





**Qualifications, Experiences, \& Skills**



* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or Mechanical, preferably with a Master’s degree in Management or Facilities Management; CMMS knowledge is also preferable
* 10 – 12 years’ experience in operations management including 5 years in a managerial role; exposure to Maintenance and Facilities Management especially in Malls /Hospitality projects

data.jd_text:
We are seeking a highly organized and execution\-oriented SPAC Project Manager to lead and coordinate the end\-to\-end execution process of a Oil \& Gas Special Purpose Acquisition Company (SPAC), from pre\-IPO readiness through IPO execution and ultimately business combination (de\-SPAC).
 



  





 The ideal candidate will act as the central coordination point between all transaction stakeholders, ensuring timelines are maintained, deliverables are completed, counterparties remain aligned, and the transaction progresses efficiently through each phase of the SPAC lifecycle.
 



  





 The role requires strong capital markets understanding, exceptional project management skills, and the ability to operate under pressure across multiple jurisdictions, advisors, and workstreams.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 Transaction \& Execution Management
 



  





 \* Coordinate the full SPAC execution process from IPO preparation through de\-SPAC completion.
 



 \* Manage transaction timelines, milestones, action trackers, and deliverable schedules.
 



 \* Drive accountability across all counterparties and advisors to ensure deadlines are met.
 



 \* Monitor critical path items and proactively resolve execution bottlenecks.
 



 \* Organize and lead transaction status calls, prepare agendas, minutes, and follow\-up actions.
 



  





 Coordination of Advisors \& Counterparties
 



  





 \* Serve as the primary coordination point among:
 



   \* Legal counsel
 



   \* Auditors
 



   \* Underwriters
 



   \* SEC counsel
 



   \* Financial advisors
 



   \* PIPE investors
 



   \* Target companies
 



   \* Sponsor entities
 



   \* IR/PR firms
 



   \* Transfer agents and other service providers
 



 \* Ensure efficient communication flow across all stakeholders.
 



  





 IPO \& Regulatory Process
 



  





 \* Support management of the IPO process, including:
 



   \* SEC comment coordination
 



   \* S\-1 amendment tracking
 



   \* FINRA and exchange\-related workstreams
 



   \* Due diligence coordination
 



   \* Data room management
 



   \* Corporate governance documentation
 



 \* Coordinate preparation and collection of transaction documentation and disclosures.
 



  





 Investor \& Marketing Materials
 



  





 \* Coordinate and manage investor\-facing materials, including:
 



   \* Investor presentations
 



   \* PIPE presentations
 



   \* Roadshow materials
 



   \* Financial and strategic summaries
 



   \* Management Q\&A documents
 



 \* Work closely with management and advisors to ensure materials are accurate, institutional\-grade, and transaction\-ready.
 



  





 De\-SPAC Execution
 



  





 \* Coordinate the business combination process from LOI through closing.
 



 \* Assist in managing:
 



   \* Due diligence workstreams
 



   \* Financial statement readiness
 



   \* Investor communication
 



   \* PIPE processes
 



   \* Regulatory filings
 



   \* Proxy/registration statement process
 



   \* Closing mechanics and timelines
 



  





 Candidate Profile
 



  





 Required Experience
 



  





 \* 3–10\+ years of experience in:
 



   \* Investment banking
 



   \* Capital markets
 



   \* SPACs
 



   \* IPO execution
 



   \* Corporate finance
 



   \* Oil \& Gas experience
 



   \* Management consulting with transaction exposure
 



 \* Prior exposure to SPAC, IPO, M\&A, PIPE, or public market transactions strongly preferred.
 



  





 Skills
 



  





 \* Strong project management and coordination abilities.
 



 \* Ability to manage multiple high\-pressure workstreams simultaneously.
 



 \* Strong understanding of transaction processes and capital markets.
 



 \* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
 



 \* High attention to detail and ability to drive execution independently.
 



 \* Advanced PowerPoint and investor presentation management skills.
 



 \* Comfortable interacting with senior executives, investors, lawyers, bankers, and auditors.
 



  





 Preferred Background
 



  





 Candidates with experience at firms such as:
 



  





 \* Investment banks
 



 \* Big 4 transaction advisory teams
 



 \* SPAC sponsors
 



 \* Capital markets advisory firms
 



 \* Public company transaction teams
 



   will be viewed favorably.
 



  





 The successful candidate becomes the operational backbone of the SPAC platform — ensuring execution discipline, maintaining transaction momentum, coordinating all counterparties effectively, and driving the process from IPO readiness to successful de\-SPAC completion.
 



  





**Please send your CV to operations@bofassetsmanagement.com**

data.jd_text:
We are looking for a Resident Architect to join our DSA team in Dubai.
 



  





**1\. Role Overview**




  





 To lead the on\-site architectural supervision and consultant services for major construction projects. This includes the administration of post\-contract responsibilities as defined by the appointment, managing and coordinating multidisciplinary site teams where applicable, ensuring alignment with the approved design intent, and monitoring compliance with the project’s contract, codes, and specifications. When appointed in a Design Guardian capacity, the role is limited to safeguarding the design intent through review, coordination, and advisory input only, and does not include construction supervision, inspection, certification, contract administration, or Defects Liability Period services unless expressly agreed and appointed under a separate scope. The role serves as a primary interface between the client, contractors, design teams, and other stakeholders. The exact scope of services may differ on a project\-by\-project basis and will be further defined as part of the project\-specific deliverables..
 



  





**2\.Job Accountabilities Linked To Objectives**




  





 The Resident Architect is responsible for leading the on\-site project team and driving the successful delivery of the project. As the most senior project representative for DSA on site, this role carries the critical responsibility of safeguarding the company’s interests, contractual, legal, and commercial responsibilities throughout the construction phase and ensuring the project aligns with DSA’s standards and obligations.
 



  





 The Resident Architect may be assigned responsibilities across one or multiple projects, as well as strategic or special initiatives aligned with the company's broader objectives. These special assignments may extend beyond project\-specific duties and can include tasks such as conducting quality audits, developing procedures, manuals and supporting internal process improvements \& development.
 



  





 In all cases, the Resident Architect is expected to work closely, not only with their direct team/ the Client but also with their immediate supervisor and line manager to clearly define the scope of responsibilities, deliverables, and resource requirements specific to each assignment. The final scope of duties and level of authority will be established in consultation with and subject to approval by the Site Operations Director, Project Director or relevant senior leadership.
 



  





**A. Design Site Leadership** 




 • Lead the site\-based lead consultancy team (where present) to ensure high standards of quality, compliance, coordination, and delivery across all stakeholders, proactively addressing deficiencies as they arise.
 



 • Oversee and assist with design deliverables, pre\-engineering, shop drawings, RFIs, submittals, inspections, and construction queries to support timely resolution and adherence to project requirements.
 



 • Review and approve works, including but not limited to mock\-ups, sample rooms, materials, and finishes, ensuring alignment with the approved design / designer, specifications, and project requirements.
 



 • Ensure effective design coordination across all disciplines and contribute to the resolution of design and construction\-related conflicts.
 



 • Conduct regular architectural and design\-focused site walks to monitor the implementation of the approved design intent, including look, feel, materiality, and spatial quality.
 



 • Identify, document, and report design, aesthetic, and quality\-related risks or non\-compliances to the LDC / Client through structured observations and reporting.
 



 • Prepare and issue monthly architectural / design guardianship reports summarising site observations, key risks, and matters requiring attention.
 



 • Review and provide comments on material samples, mock\-ups, mood boards, finishes, look \& feel assessments, and sample rooms to support alignment with the approved design intent.
 



 • Provide architectural and interior design clarifications, including aesthetic and design intent matters, where requested by the Client.
 



 • Participate in value engineering and design development discussions, providing input on architectural quality, aesthetic impact, and alignment with the approved design intent.
 



 • Coordinate closely with PMCM, the Contractor, and the wider consultant team during site reviews, technical meetings, and design discussions to maintain alignment between design intent, construction execution, and client expectations.
 



 • Monitor that the executed works reflect the approved design, client expectations, and applicable codes and regulations throughout the construction process.
 



 • Ensure RFIs, approvals, instructions, and IFC changes are managed through the established project communication and authority channels and are properly coordinated across all parties.
 



 • Produce and issue timely internal and external dashboards capturing progress, quality, design alignment, and emerging risks.
 



  





**B. Site Supervision Team Management** 




 • Direct and manage the day\-to\-day performance of DSA's site supervision team (architects, engineers, inspectors, sub\-consultants and the like).
 



 • Ensure all team members are properly briefed on their roles and responsibilities.
 



 • Implement structured delegation and reporting mechanisms.
 



 • Conduct periodic audits, QA/QC / technical reviews, and performance assessments.
 



 • Maintain a collaborative, professional, and high\-performing supervision environment on site.
 



 • Ensure employees / team members conduct are upheld to the highest standards
 



 • Monitor and update in coordination with the Client and Site Operations Director the project, staff deployment, associated schedule and ensure timely delivery of the same at the agreed frequency
 



  





**C. Project \& Contract Administration** 




 • Oversee compliance with the project’s construction contract (FIDIC or equivalent).
 



 • Issue formal communications, manage variations, evaluate contractor claims, and contribute to extension of time assessments.
 



 • Ensure proper documentation, records \& communication protocols are established, used and maintained for all supervision activities.
 



 • Coordinate with the Employer’s Representative and Client\-appointed Consultants.
 



 • Act as Engineer’s Representative / Employer’s Representative if appointed, ensuring responsibilities are discharged in line with the delegated authority.
 



 • Assist in stake holder and lead in team dispute resolution
 



  





**D. Project Coordination \& Stakeholder Interface** 




 • Act as the senior site representative of the lead consultant.
 



 • Establish and manage coordination mechanisms among the consultant team, contractor, suppliers, and client representatives.
 



 • Participate in progress meetings, site coordination meetings, and technical reviews.
 



 • Monitor and steer project progress and associated scheduling and produce relevant reports
 



 • Provide strategic input and advice to the client to ensure project objectives are met.
 



  





**E. Quality \& Compliance Oversight** 




 • Enforce quality control standards and escalate issues that risk the design quality or compliance of the project / deliverables
 



 • Monitor health, safety, and environmental practices on site.
 



 • Participate in final inspections, testing, and commissioning phases.
 



 • Ensure defect lists, non\-conformance reports and site observations are compiled and rectified in line with contract obligations.
 



 • Ensure pre\-engineering deliverables are in line with contract agreement and implement measures to maintain and or rectify resulting shortfalls
 



 • Monitor and advise on change control process
 



  





**F. Leadership \& Mentorship** 




 • Serve as mentor and technical advisor to staff, engineers and sub\-consultants.
 



 • Lead internal training and onboarding of new site staff.
 



 • Foster a knowledge\-sharing culture that emphasizes continuous improvement and professional development to the benefit of the project and company.
 



  





**G. Commercial \& Invoicing Responsibilities** 




 • Coordinate with the head office/accounts team to prepare and validate monthly consultancy service invoices in line with contract terms.
 



 • Review and confirm site\-based and related staff, timesheets for inclusion in monthly billing.
 



 • Collect, verify, and consolidate sub\-consultant timesheets for accuracy, completeness, and scope alignment.
 



 • Track sub\-consultant invoices and ensure timely submission to accounts for processing.
 



 • Maintain a project\-specific log of all invoicing activities, including issue dates, payment terms, and receipt confirmations amongst others.
 



 • Monitor outstanding invoices and follow up with clients and relevant stakeholders to ensure prompt payment.
 



 • Flag and escalate delays in payment or disputed invoices to the Project Director and commercial team.
 



 • Liaise with sub\-consultants regarding their payment status and provide updates on payment cycles and client approvals.
 



 • Ensure compliance with internal financial procedures and contractual invoicing requirements.
 



 • Support monthly project \& financial reporting with updates on invoice status, forecasted income, and payment risks.
 



 • Assist in reconciling client payment records with internal accounts to resolve discrepancies, if any.
 



 • Track any approved variations or scope changes and coordinate with the commercial team to ensure these are invoiced accordingly.
 



  





**3\. Qualification / Experience / Requirements**




  





 • Qualified Architect (BArch / MArch) with minimum 15 years’ experience; at least 10 years on\-site in the Middle East.
 



 • Proven experience as a Resident Architect on large\-scale or complex projects.
 



 • Strong working knowledge of FIDIC contract administration and construction management practices.
 



 • Experience managing multidisciplinary supervision teams in fast\-track environments.
 



 • Familiar with UAE/ Regional Authority codes, regulations, and approval procedures.
 



 • PMP, MCIOB, or similar certifications are advantageous.
 



 • Strong documentation, reporting, technical and problem\-solving capabilities.
 



  





 Interested candidates can share their resume directly on recruit.dxb@dsa\-arch.com mentioning "Resident Architect" as a subject.

data.jd_text:
**A Snapshot of your Day**
 As a Project Procurement Manager you represent Supply Chain in the Project/Proposal Management Team and acts as the Sub\-project Manager leading the Project SCM strategy for Compressor packages. You will integrate procurement in the project management process and project teams and be involved during the sales phase. You will organize all procurement activities in a project under optimum deployment of resources. You also implement procurement strategies aiming to optimize project results, including availability of goods and services in quality, in time, in budget while ensuring observance of obligatory Procurement processes and regulations.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Early Involvement during sales phase: Analyze sales and operations planning in respect of starting/new projects in order to ensure the involvement of Procurement. Participate in project/sales meetings as project core team member to provide information about supply market, preferred suppliers and supplier innovation (regarding goods and services) at an early stage to optimize supplier strategy and selection of Major CTO and ETO equipment, such as Motors, Gears, Gas Engines, Acoustics equipment, Auxiliaries (Lube Systems, Gas Seal panels, etc); diversified components (Dry Gas Seals, Anti\-Surge Valves, other); extended scope such as WHRU, HRSG, Balance of Plant.
* Project Procurement standards: Establish proper sourcing processes, control all Procurement resources and activities in the project and inform all involved within Procurement to deliver optimum impact for the business (Procurement plan, target\-costing) relating to budget, availability, timeline and quality. Apply Procurement regulations as per Compliance, organization standards and PM@Siemens Energy
* Analysis: Analyze scope of supply, contractual obligations and exactly understand customer’s functional needs.Identify Procurement risks, opportunities, potential changes, claims and market forces during the entire project, together with Commodity Management, to avoid potential damage / exploit potential.
* Strategy definition and implementation: Derive Procurement strategy for assigned projects in accordance with Business Unit \& Operating Company Procurement strategies and ensure implementation. Introduce negotiation recommendations together with Commodity Management to prepare for negotiations with suppliers (back\-to\-back where appropriate) and to initiate appropriate measures.
* Negotiation: Lead complex contractual and price, cash flow and commercial T\&C negotiations and/or support the specialist buyers responsible for particular material fields (in particular those not covered by any Commodity Management) to secure project targets with optimum conditions on the basis of ToCO.
* Contract Management: Ensure that major Procurement risks, changes to original scope of supply and potential claims (towards customers and suppliers) are covered in valid contracts. Ensure that contractual obligations (towards the customer that must be fulfilled by supplier) are covered in a way that mitigates the own risk exposure.
* Supplier Management / Preferred Supplier List: Apply preferred supplier list (e.g. FPL), provide supplier information to the project team, coordinate Supplier Management in preparation for transition to Project execution phase (including Supplier Qualification, project\-specific supplier evaluations and supplier development).
* Knowledge management and documentation: Be proactive and forward systematically all relevant Procurement related project information (e.g. updated contractual conditions, Supplier Management data) to keep all project participants and relevant cross\-functional partners up to date. Share best practice and conduct lessons learn sessions. Sensitize cross\-functional partners for Procurement related practices processes and metrics.


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree (B.S.) in an engineering discipline with minimum 5 years of relevant experience; or M.S. degree in engineering discipline with 3 years of relevant experience; or M.B.A with technical B.S. degree with 3 years of relevant experience; or equivalent education and experience.
* Compression and/or Gas Turbine major equipment relevant technical proficiency preferred
* 5 Years experience minimum combined in related SCM functions, Project Procurement, Proposal and/or Project Management within Oil and Gas or Power Generation industry.
* Advanced MS Office applications skills, particularly Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint
* Advanced knowledge of sourcing process
* Advanced negotiation skills
* Good problem solving skills
* Cost Modeling
* Ability to work in a matrix organization
* Advanced data analytics
* Leader, self\-manage
* Ability to run presentations to management level
* Availability to travel estimated 15% of time


**About The Team**
 Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Energy?**
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
   

  

 Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
   

  

 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
   

  

**Rewards/Benefits**
* Opportunities to work with a global team

 Candidates with experience in:

ChillBase studio is an independent and innovative player in the gaming industry. We’re fueled by our passion for crafting outstanding products.
 



  





 We’re creating
 **OneState** 
 , a mobile life simulator built in Unity. Our art team is facing ambitious challenges as we develop the project with a realistic approach and high standards for visual quality and technical solutions. We use modern technologies and tools, continuously refining our pipelines and aiming for the highest level of quality and immersion.
 



  





 If you are seeking to be a part of an engaged team, work on captivating projects with minimal bureaucracy, and receive regular, constructive feedback, then you’ll find your place with us.
 



  





**Expectations** 




  





**What we want to see** 



* Experience as an Art Director or Head of Art on game projects
* Strong expertise in mobile AAA realism
* Deep understanding of mobile platform limitations and how to work within them
* Experience building art systems, standards, and processes
* Experience collaborating with producers and directors as partners
* Strong skills in presenting and defending creative decisions
* Cross platform experience with mobile, PC, or console projects is a strong plus
* Strategic mindset
* High level of ownership and responsibility
* Strong communication skills
* Focus on results and business value
* Willingness to work in a partnership model rather than manual micromanagement



  





**What you will be doing** 



* Shaping and evolving the project’s art strategy together with the CCO
* Building an autonomous art structure including roles, ownership, standards, and processes
* Ensuring AAA level quality and visual consistency across the product
* Making key visual decisions and defending them at the producer and director level
* Developing head level roles and growing strong leaders within the art team
* Managing the balance between quality, timelines, cost, and value
* Growing the art direction as a driver of product and IP growth



  





**Benefits** 




  





**Growth and development** 




 Our project is actively growing, as well as the team that creates it. We invest in the growth of each specialist and regularly review salaries based on performance. Moreover, we have a promotion system that allows specialists to showcase their talents in more responsible positions.
 



  





**Comfortable conditions** 




 You can choose various work types: hybrid or office. Also we have flexible hours with the option of taking days off.
 



  





**Care for employees** 




 We offer sick days without salary loss, assistance in difficult life situations, no bureaucratic nightmares and processes for the sake of processes.
 



  





**Relocation assistance** 




 If you’re ready to join the team at our hub in Dubai, we will help you make it happen.
 



  





**Employment** 




 We offer an employment system, including official labor relations in Dubai, as well as any other options that suit you.
 



  





**We carefully review every application and will definitely reach out if your profile matches the role’s requirements. If you do not receive a response within 14 calendar days, it means we are not moving forward with your application at this stage. We’d be happy to reconnect in the future — please keep an eye on our openings.**

**About Us** 




 This marketing agency is hiring a commercially minded, hands\-on Media Strategist to own and scale paid campaigns across Google and Meta, while supporting expansion into new platforms.
 



 As a UK\-headquartered business operating globally, strong professional English communication is essential.
 



 You will take full ownership of assigned products, accountable for lead volume, CPA, quality, and margin performance. Reporting to the Head of Media, you’ll execute strategy while driving day\-to\-day optimisation and growth.
 



 This is a delivery\-focused role with clear commercial performance expectations — not a coordination position.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Owns paid media strategy and execution for assigned products
* Builds, launches, and scales campaigns across Google Ads and Meta
* Manages performance against clear CPA, ROAS, and margin targets
* Monitors campaigns daily and makes decisive optimisation changes
* Tests new creative approaches, audiences, bidding models, and landing page strategies
* Develops and iterates ad copy across Google and Meta, including RSA headline and description variants, Meta primary text and CTAs, and landing page messaging
* Briefs creative assets with clear strategic rationale and systematically tests messaging hypotheses using performance data to inform future iterations
* Contributes to expansion into new platforms such as YouTube, TikTok, Native, and Programmatic where commercially justified
* Collaborates closely with Tech, Ops, and Content teams to improve lead quality and conversion efficiency
* Uses data to generate insights by identifying trends, diagnosing issues, and proposing clear action plans
* Leverages generative AI tools to research products and markets, generate insights, and analyse campaign data to identify efficiency gains and commercial opportunities
* Provides structured and concise performance reporting to the Head of Media



  





**Qualifications:** 



* Has 3–7 years of experience managing paid media campaigns, with strong hands\-on expertise in Google Ads and Meta (5\+ years preferred)
* Demonstrates proven experience running lead generation campaigns with clear commercial accountability
* Has a strong track record of working against strict CPA and performance targets
* Possesses strong analytical capability and is comfortable working with performance data on a daily basis
* Demonstrates strong commercial awareness, with a clear understanding that success is measured by profitability and scalability rather than traffic alone
* Brings experience across additional platforms such as Bing, YouTube, Native, TikTok, and similar channels, which is considered advantageous
* Has experience marketing within regulated sectors such as financial services, insurance, legal, or healthcare; familiarity with FCA advertising standards or equivalent is highly advantageous
* Actively uses generative AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent platforms as part of daily workflow, including copy generation, creative briefing, performance analysis, and reporting
* Demonstrates exceptional written and spoken English fluency at a business and client\-ready level
* Has experience marketing products within the UK or other native English\-speaking markets, which is considered highly advantageous
* Exhibits a high\-ownership mentality and thrives in a results\-driven environment
* Is most likely currently based in Dubai, although exceptional candidates requiring relocation support may also be considered



  





**What the company offers:** 



* Offers a competitive salary alongside a monthly performance\-based bonus structure typically valued at approximately 15% of gross salary
* Provides clear performance accountability with strong opportunities for career progression
* Enables direct involvement in strategic decision\-making across multiple verticals, supported by a short reporting line and genuine commercial ownership of accounts from day one
* Presents a high\-impact, high\-autonomy role within a growing media team
* Supports a flexible working culture, including remote working where appropriate
* Offers the opportunity to work within a business actively investing in innovation and AI\-enabled marketing

data.jd_text:
The Executive Assistant (EA) will report to the Head of Middle East. This is a key role within the Middle East team. The successful candidate will bring substantial EA experience, gained within an international Law Firm(s) based in the Middle East. A high level of professionalism, discretion and commercial awareness is essential.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 This is a full\-time, fixed\-term position of up to eight months to cover maternity leave. Working hours are Monday to Friday, 9 00am to 6 00pm, with the option to work from home one day per week.
   

  




  


  

  

 We are seeking an agile, highly organised and responsive professional who is passionate about providing outstanding EA support to the Head of Middle East and contributing positively to the wider team. The role requires someone who can proactively manage competing priorities, build strong working relationships with stakeholders at all levels, and consistently deliver work to a high standard. The ideal candidate will take pride in going above and beyond, while exercising sound judgement and maintaining confidentiality at all times.
   

  

 Please note that, as part of the recruitment process, successful shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete Numeracy, Comprehension and Prioritisation assessments, which will take approximately 60 minutes in total.
   

  




  


**Please apply directly through with your application and kindly only contact our Recruitment team for any further details, legal experiance is essential part of the criteria for this role.**
  

  
   

  




  


 Roles and Responsibilities
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Executive support, Diary \& Stakeholder Management
   

  

  
   

  




  


 This may include but is not limited to the following
   

  

 •Proactively manage the Head of Middle East’s complex and high‑volume diary, including scheduling internal and external meetings across multiple time zones, often involving numerous senior stakeholders with competing priorities.
   

  

 •Act as a gatekeeper for the Head of Middle East, triaging meeting requests, queries, issues and complaints, redirecting appropriately while ensuring matters are dealt with effectively and without unnecessary involvement from the Head.
   

  

 •Prepare agendas, attend meetings where the Head of Middle East is attending or chairing, take detailed notes and action logs, and proactively follow up with action owners to ensure completion within agreed timeframes.
   

  

 •Attend additional meetings alongside or on behalf of the Head of Middle East where appropriate, independently managing follow‑up actions and keeping the Head fully briefed.
   

  

 •Support the Head of Middle East with strategic and commercial decision‑making by proactively preparing briefing materials, summaries, background information and data to ensure decisions are well‑informed.
   

  

 •Anticipate information requirements and liaise with Finance, BD, HR, Compliance and other Business Operations teams to ensure relevant input is available in advance of key meetings or decisions.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Travel, Logistics \& Trip Optimisation
   

  

 •Arrange end‑to‑end complex travel for the Head of Middle East, including multi‑destination international itineraries, coordination of different modes of transport, accommodation and airport transfers.
   

  

 •Manage all visas, permits and travel documentation, ensuring sufficient lead time and compliance with jurisdiction‑specific requirements.
   

  

 •Provide strategic input into travel planning, designing trips that maximise effectiveness by combining multiple objectives (client meetings, internal meetings, events and business development) into a single itinerary where possible.
   

  

 •Liaise extensively with colleagues across offices and business functions to ensure a joined‑up firm approach and maximise the value of each trip.
   

  

 •Remain flexible and responsive, managing last‑minute changes to travel and schedules calmly and efficiently when required.
   

  

 •Prepare detailed post‑trip reports summarising meetings held, key outcomes, opportunities identified and agreed next steps, for circulation to relevant internal stakeholders.
   

  

 •Ensure all follow‑up meetings and actions arising from travel are diarised promptly, tracked and progressed to completion.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Marketing / Business Development Support
   

  

 •Manage speaking engagements and thought‑leadership commitments, including tracking article and submission deadlines, coordinating preparatory research, and drafting briefing materials such as panel questions or speaker scripts.
   

  

 •Arrange and coordinate preparatory and briefing meetings in advance of panels, speaking slots or publications, ensuring the Head of Middle East is fully prepared.
   

  

 •Liaise with the Knowledge team and other internal stakeholders to obtain research support and background material where required, to ensure contributions are accurate, relevant and high quality.
   

  

 •Register the Head of Middle East for events when instructed and prepare comprehensive pre‑event briefings, including attendee information and engagement objectives, to maximise the value of attendance.
   

  

 •Working with the Head of Middle East and Business Development teams to maintain up‑to‑date client target lists.
   

  

 •Track and maintain updates on client target status, ensuring actions and deliverables assigned to relationship partners are followed up and progressed.
   

  

 •Provide regular status updates to the Head of Middle East on progress, upcoming actions and any slippage against agreed objectives.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Billing, Finance \& Expenses
   

  

 •Manage the full monthly billing process for the Head of Middle East’s matters, maintaining detailed knowledge of client fee agreements, caps and billing arrangements.
   

  

 •Prepare draft bills for approval, liaise with Finance as required, and issue final approved invoices to clients in their preferred format with appropriate covering correspondence.
   

  

 •Manage client billing queries in coordination with Finance and the Head of Middle East.
   

  

 •Maintain oversight of expense submissions for the Head of Middle East, including liaising directly with vendors (restaurants and transport providers etc) to obtain duplicate receipts or supporting documentation where receipts were not provided or have been misplaced.
   

  

 •Ensure expenses are accurately described, correctly coded and supported by appropriate budget holder approval in line with firm policy.
   

  

 •Proactively follow up with clients regarding outstanding invoices and payments, providing regular updates to the Head of Middle East and keeping the Billing and Finance teams fully informed of progress, issues or agreed payment timelines.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Performance \& People Processes
   

  

 •Support the Head of Middle East throughout the performance review process, ensuring review meetings are scheduled in line with firm‑wide deadlines.
   

  

 •Prepare performance review meeting packs, ensuring all required documentation and financial data are available in advance.
   

  

 •Proactively monitor and follow up to ensure reviewees complete required system inputs ahead of meetings.
   

  

 •Attend performance review meetings to take detailed notes and assist the Head of Middle East during discussions.
   

  

 •Support completion of post‑meeting evaluations, notes and system requirements, ensuring timely and accurate submission.
   

  

 •Maintain oversight of outstanding actions arising from performance reviews.
   

  

 •Maintain close and regular communication with HR throughout the performance review cycle, ensuring awareness of progress, confirming deadlines, understanding process or system changes, and ensuring all requirements are met accurately and on time.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 CRM \& Relationship Management
   

  

 •Maintain and update the Head of Middle East’s contacts and relationship data in InterAction, ensuring activities, meetings and relationship notes are accurately recorded.
   

  

 •Support the Head of Middle East in managing and maintaining effective working relationships with other law firms and referrers, supporting collaboration across jurisdictions.
   

  

 •Track inbound and outbound referrals between the firm and external law firms, ensuring referrals are recorded accurately and progress is monitored.
   

  

 •Support the Head of Middle East in ensuring referral relationships are actively maintained, with appropriate follow‑up on agreed actions and opportunities.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Recruitment \& Business Operations Liaison
   

  

 •Maintain oversight of Middle East recruitment activity, liaising with HR and providing regular updates to the Head of Middle East.
   

  

 •Act as a key coordination point with Business Operations functions (HR, Finance, BD, Compliance, IT and Operations), ensuring strong communication, alignment and effective delivery of initiatives impacting the region.
   

  

 •Establish regular Middle East Operations meetings, ensuring all Business Operations functions are kept informed, aligned and engaged on regional matters.
   

  

 •Use these forums to share relevant knowledge or developments that may impact specific functions, agree deliverables, and capture upcoming activities, deadline changes and requirements that should be on the Head of Middle East’s radar.
   

  

 •Ensure key outputs from Middle East Operations meetings are fed into agendas and briefing materials for wider Middle East leadership or team meetings, promoting alignment and proactive planning across the region.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Person Specification
   

  

 •Proven experience as an Executive Assistant, Legal PA or similar role supporting a senior Partner or regional lead, ideally within an international law firm or professional services environment.
   

  

 •Demonstrable experience managing complex diaries and multi‑time‑zone scheduling for senior stakeholders.
   

  

 •Strong experience arranging complex international travel, including multi‑destination itineraries, visas and short‑notice changes.
   

  

 •Experience supporting billing and financial processes, including preparation of draft bills, liaising with Finance and following up on client payments.
   

  

 •Experience supporting people and performance review processes, including scheduling review meetings, preparing documentation and assisting with system requirements.
   

  

 •Experience working closely with HR, Finance, BD, Compliance and other Business Operations teams, with the ability to coordinate and track actions effectively.
   

  

 •Highly organised, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment.
   

  

 •Strong written and verbal communication skills, with confidence drafting correspondence and reports on behalf of a senior leader.
   

  

 •Ability to exercise sound judgement, discretion and confidentiality when handling sensitive matters.
   

  

 •Proactive, flexible and resilient, with the ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities.
   

  

 •Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, with experience using practice management, CRM and expense management systems.
   

  

 •Professional, client‑focused approach, with the confidence to liaise directly with senior internal stakeholders and clients.
   

  

 •Fluent written and spoken English.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Benefits include (but are not limited to)
   

  

 •Competitive salary (negotiable depending on experience)
   

  

 •Premium international medical, dental, and optical insurance
   

  

 •30 days of annual leave
   

  

 •Employee Assistance Programme
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Competencies
   

  

 •Working together
   

  

 •Integrity and respect
   

  

 •Inclusive
   

  

 •Personal impact and growth
   

  

 •Driving high standards
   

  

 •Commercial mindset
   

  

 •Client \- centric
   

  

 •Responsible

**Job Description**
 As a global leader in aviation technologies, Honeywell Aerospace develops advanced products such as integrated cockpits, jet engines, and cutting\-edge connectivity solutions.
