 **Sales Manager for Aerospace Connectivity Solutions** 
 to drive our sales initiatives in the Business Aviation and Head of State markets in the Middle East, Africa and India region. This role requires a strategic thinker with a strong demonstrated background in airborne connectivity solutions and a proven ability to drive sales growth and customer satisfaction. The connectivity portfolio encompasses satellite communications for cabin Wi\-Fi, on\-board networks, cockpit datalink and safety services. The Sales Manager will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building client relationships, creating winning propositions, and achieving sales targets. This role requires a blend of commercial insight, industry and technical expertise, and sales acumen.

* Sales Forecasting and Reporting: Grow and manage sales pipeline within the CRM system.

**Qualifications**

* Proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales targets and driving business growth.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Willingness to travel as needed to meet with clients and attend industry events.


 Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret market trends and customer requirements are essential for success in this role.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

data.jd_text:
**About the Role:** 




 The Head of QA is the enterprise quality authority, responsible for transforming RAKBANK’s approach to software quality into a modern, automation\-first, AI\-driven quality engineering function.
 



  





 This role will lead the shift from manual, end\-of\-cycle testing to continuous, embedded quality across the full software development lifecycle. Working closely with Digital, Engineering, and Platform teams, the role ensures all releases meet the robustness and compliance standards required in a regulated banking environment.
 



  





**What You’ll Be Doing:** 



* Define and drive the enterprise QA strategy, including automation\-first and AI\-assisted testing adoption
* Establish and lead a Quality Engineering Centre of Excellence, standardising tools, frameworks, and best practices
* Embed quality across the SDLC through shift\-left practices, CI/CD quality gates, and squad\-level ownership
* Own test automation strategy across UI, API, and data layers; track coverage and ROI
* Implement AI\-driven testing (e.g., self\-healing automation, intelligent test prioritisation, defect triage)
* Lead non\-functional testing (performance, resilience, security, and API contract testing)
* Govern test environments and test data management, including synthetic data and data masking
* Oversee UAT governance and own release quality sign\-off (go/no\-go decisions)
* Define and report QA metrics (defect leakage, automation coverage, cycle time, incident rates)
* Build and lead the QA function, including capability development and team structure



  





**What We’re Looking For:** 



* 12\+ years of experience in software quality engineering
* 5\+ years in a senior QA leadership role (Head / Director level)
* Experience in banking, fintech, or regulated financial services environments
* Proven track record of leading QA transformation from manual to automation\-led environments
* Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile delivery, and CI/CD\-integrated quality practices
* Exposure to AI\-driven testing and emerging QA technologies
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or similar
* ISTQB Advanced Test Manager certification (preferred: Expert level or equivalent)



  





**Skills:** 



* QA strategy and transformation leadership
* Automation frameworks (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Appium, etc.)
* CI/CD integration and quality gate governance
* Performance testing and resilience engineering (JMeter, Gatling, k6\)
* Test data management (synthetic data, PII masking, governance)
* AI\-driven testing tools and practices
* Stakeholder management and executive reporting
* Team leadership, mentoring, and capability building



  





**What You’ll Gain:** 



* Competitive compensation and performance\-based incentives
* Medical coverage for you and your family
* Comprehensive life insurance
* Exposure to high\-impact strategic projects
* Supportive and inclusive workplace culture
* Opportunities for career advancement and professional development

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**
 Fleet Technical Management at Emirates comprises five specialized teams dedicated to maintaining the highest standards of service and reliability for our fleet.
   

  

**Airframe Systems:** 
 Handles mechanical systems including flight controls, landing gear, and air conditioning.
   

  

**Structures** 
 : Supports aircraft structures, including repairs and modifications for metallic and composite parts.
   

  

**Avionics** 
 : Manages avionics systems, including navigation, communications, and advanced IFE systems.
   

  

**Powerplant** 
 : Oversees engines and APUs, focusing on health monitoring and optimization.
   

  

**Cabin** 
 : Maintains passenger cabins, flight decks, and retrofits, ensuring top\-notch comfort and functionality.
   

  

 Each team ensures our fleet operates efficiently and safely, meeting all technical and service standards.
   

  

 As a Technical Services Engineer I \- Cabin Upgrades and Reconfigurations (Inflight Entertainment and Connectivity) you will provide fleet technical management, continuing airworthiness management and technical support functions for Emirates fleet to ensure compliance to regulatory \& safety requirements, reliability, passenger comfort and cost effectiveness.
   

  

**In This Role You Will**
* Provide fleet technical management, continuing airworthiness management and technical support functions for Cabin Interior.
* Routinely evaluate manufacturers/regulatory authorities’ technical documents, taking appropriate actions and update internal engineering documents including Engineering Order and Special Engineering Workcard.
* Review in\-service data (e.g Tech log, Pilot Reports, Defects) and implement actions to improve fleet, engine, component and/or system reliability and maintainability, including optimisation of aircraft maintenance programs.
* Deliver technical assistance and operational support in disruptions scenarios including the handling of technical/AOG, troubleshooting, aircraft chronic and deferred defects and technical delays.
* Carry out Emirates Engineering design organisational activities such as but not limited to development of standard operating procedures, in house repairs, use of alternate parts, deviations from manufacturing documents by exercising Design Engineer (DE) privileges of Part 21 Design Organisation as appointed by Head of Design (HOD).
* Provide support and expertise for acquisition of new Aircraft and end of lease activities
* Act as a technical liaison with Aircraft, Engines and/or Component Manufacturers and internal stakeholders (e.g flight operations, service delivery) to address fleet significant faults, defects, design issues and quality escapements.
* Provide technical clarifications/justification to internal stakeholders in support of cost optimisation, contract negotiation, repair and modification processes.
* Carry out project management functions such as but not limited to major modifications, retrofits, cabin reconfigurations and aircraft phaseout requirements including preparation of cost benefit studies or budget requirements on changes/repairs with recommendations/proposals for approval by management.
* Review and analyse technical data in support of department KPIs, highlighting trends and making recommendation reports/proposal for improvement.


 Qualification
   

  

**To be considered for the role you must meet the below requirements:**
* Degree or Honours (12\+3 or equivalent).
* More than 10 years of experience in Engineering, Aeronautical.
* Degree in Aeronautical/Avionics/Mechanical/Electrical Engineering and/or holder of Aircraft Maintenance Engineering Licence for 5 years.
* Related Aircraft Engineering experience.
* Should have a minimum of 8 years in Technical Services function of which at least 5 years of experience pertaining to Emirates fleet type/aircraft systems.
* Knowledge of latest technical developments and industry trends on respective systems.
* Ability to analyse and synthesise technical information for implementation in cost effective ways.
* Excellent drafting/report writing skills.
* Demonstrable experience in managing complex tasks and decision making in a fast\-paced environment.


 Salary \& benefits
   

  

 Join us in a management role and enjoy an attractive tax\-free salary. On top of our generous travel benefits, including discounted flights and hotel stays around the world, this managerial role also has an excellent leave and healthcare package. That’s on top of transport benefits, life insurance and more. Find out what it’s like to live and work in our fast\-paced, cosmopolitan home city in the Dubai Lifestyle section of our website www.emirates.com/careers

* 10\+ years of progressive experience in mechanical engineering design, with significant focus on data centre and mission\-critical facilities
* Demonstrated expertise in data centre mechanical systems, including chilled water plant design (chillers, pumps, distribution systems), air handling and distribution (CRAH/CRAC units, ducting, containment strategies), high\-density cooling solutions (direct liquid cooling, rear\-door heat exchangers), fire suppression systems (clean agent, water\-based), and energy\-efficient HVAC design incorporating economizers and free cooling strategies

* Significant experience with projects in the GCC and broader EMEA region, with an understanding of regional codes, standards, and stakeholder dynamics
* Working knowledge of relevant mechanical engineering standards including ASHRAE (90\.1, TC 9\.9\), NFPA codes, and energy efficiency metrics (PUE, DCiE)
* Strong client relationship management skills with demonstrated ability to independently manage senior\-level client interactions and build lasting partnerships
* Business development experience, including proposal leadership, technical presentations, scope definition, and fee negotiation
* Demonstrated political acumen and ability to navigate complex organizational environments, manage competing stakeholder interests, and operate effectively in matrix structures
* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related discipline; Chartered Engineer (CEng) or Professional Engineer (PE) status strongly preferred


**Responsibilities**

* Provide technical advisory services to clients during procurement, design review, and construction phases, including contractor submittal reviews, RFI resolution, and technical assurance for project delivery
* Lead multidisciplinary coordination efforts, ensuring seamless integration between mechanical, electrical, architectural, structural, and other design disciplines

* Support business development initiatives, including proposal preparation, technical presentations, fee negotiations, and strategic client engagement

data.jd_text:
**Job Summary**
**About SC Ventures**
 SC Ventures is Standard Chartered’s innovation, fintech investment and ventures arm. We were established to reinvent banking, as the significant technological disruptions to the industry was impacting its ability to serve clients and customers, in the ways they needed to be served.
   

  

 We are a unique ecosystem of innovators, banking experts, business builders and partners who are focused on rewiring the DNA in banking and bringing breakthrough ideas to scale, together.
   

  

 We are building ecosystems around four high conviction themes: Online Economy \& Lifestyle, SMEs \& World Trade, Digital Assets, and Sustainability \& Inclusion.
   

  

 We are a global team of "Members" (excluding individual ventures), including dedicated colleagues from the Group's support functions, based in Singapore, Hong Kong, London, and the United Arab Emirates
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 The Innovation and Venture Designer is a senior individual contributor at the forefront of shaping what banking can become next. Reporting to and supporting the Head of Innovation and Design, this role will define, design, and deliver customer\-centric digital and service experiences across the SC Ventures portfolio, turning bold ideas into ventures that can scale in market.
   

  

 This is a role for someone energised by change, ambiguity, and the challenge of building in fast\-moving markets. The role holder will apply human\-centred design and product design expertise to unlock better customer outcomes, accelerate venture validation, and strengthen product\-market fit. The role carries Director\-level accountability, autonomy, and influence, working closely with venture CEOs, product leaders, engineers, and senior stakeholders to shape high\-impact decisions.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
**Proposition Shaping**
* Support the shaping of bold, differentiated venture concepts grounded in emerging trends across AI, fintech, and digital business models.
* Apply strong commercial acumen and customer insight to focus efforts on high\-potential opportunity spaces and translate them into compelling venture hypotheses.
* Work closely with venture leads, technologists, investors, and senior stakeholders to develop and refine co\-created early\-stage venture ideas.
* Leverage AI augmentation and modern design tools to accelerate ideation, concept development, and early prototyping.


**Proposition Validation**
* Turn bold venture ideas into tangible prototypes that can be tested with real users and evaluated for seed investment by the Investment Committee.
* Run fast, hands\-on validation cycles to test assumptions, gather customer insight, and build robust evidence for or against investment decisions.
* Rapidly design, prototype, and iterate using modern tools including Figma and AI tools such as Claude.
* Translate complex ideas into clear, compelling narratives and artifacts that are simple, decision\-ready, and investment\-grade.


**Product Design \& Venture Build**
* Apply strong UX, service design, and prototyping craft to move from ambiguity to clarity at speed, shaping intuitive and high\-impact user experiences.
* Support ventures post\-seed by refining early\-stage product, user journeys, and experience design.
* Create prototypes and product concepts that bridge strategy, technology, and customer experience.
* Embed AI augmentation into product design to enhance user value, differentiation, and scalability.
* Ensure alignment between customer needs, business viability, and technical feasibility across early\-stage product development.


**Overall Mindset**
* Be comfortable operating in zero\-to\-one environments, balancing creativity, speed, and rigour.
* Bring a solid understanding of fintech ecosystems and digital business models, with sound commercial judgment.
* Thrive in a fast\-moving, experimental environment where building, testing, and learning quickly matters most..


**Risk Management**
* Adhere to Policies and Procedures.
* Act and escalate quickly when any risk and control weakness become apparent and ensure they are addressed within an appropriate timeframe and escalated through the relevant committees.
* Work with SCV colleagues to deliver expected business performance results within cost constraints and applicable risk/ control framework to ensure that the Group’s ability to remain within risk appetite is not materially threatened.


**Governance**
* Have an awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.


**Regulatory \& Business Conduct**
* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.


**Key stakeholders**
* Head of Innovation and Design
* Venture leads
* SC Ventures leadership


**Other Responsibilities**
* Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in the business and SC Ventures;
* Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures.


**Skills And Experience**
* Influence
* UX/UI Design
* Innovation
* Business Acumen
* Strategic Thinking


**Qualifications**
* 10\+ years’ experience across facilitation, product design, product commercialisation, innovation design, UX/UI and/or consulting
* Experience working in AI augmented or automation rich product environments, leveraging AI tools or agents to accelerate discovery and delivery
* Ability to define intent, constraints, and evaluation criteria for AI generated outputs across design and innovation workflows
* Strong systems thinking: comfortable designing workflows, guardrails, and governance rather than only artefacts
* Proven track record designing complex, customer\-facing digital products at scale
* Strong expertise in UX research, interaction design, visual design, and prototyping (Claude Code/Cursor in addition to Figma)
* Experience operating at Director\-level influence without formal people management
* Strong understanding of agile product development and cross\-functional delivery models
* Ability to clearly articulate design decisions to senior, non\-design stakeholders


**About Standard Chartered**
 We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
   

  

 Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
   

  

**Together We**
* Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
* Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term


**What We Offer**
**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,** 
 we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
   

  

* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time\-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market\-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first\-aiders and all sorts of self\-help toolkits
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies \- everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

data.jd_text:
Pattern is a leading eCommerce accelerator with offices across the globe offering outsourced marketplace and ecommerce management services for brands worldwide. The Pattern Ecommerce Acceleration Platform leverages AI\-powered technology, industry expertise, and global distribution, logistics, and fulfilment services to help quality brands scale profitably on their own websites and through hundreds of marketplaces. Pattern works with some of the most recognized brands such as Thorne, Naturelo, Marshall, Nutricost, MegaFood, TIGI, Hair Burst and Sage and it ranks among the top 5 Amazon sellers globally.
   

  

 Pattern is expanding and we are looking for an experienced Ecommerce expert to join our MENA Team in Dubai to support the scaling of the business by driving the performance of the brands we represent on Amazon and other Marketplaces.
   

  

 You will own the relationship and financial performance of a portfolio of global brands managing their performance across marketplaces here in MENA. You will support the Associate Director of eCommerce with defining and implementing the E2E growth and profitability plan for your portfolio of brands by working cross\-functionally with Operations, Content, Advertising, Creative, Merchandising and Finance. You will also lead cross\-functional projects to implement processes to scale the organisation in MENA. You will be a strategic and commercial ecommerce professional who can engage partners and internal stakeholders towards a common goal. You will have a growth mindset and love navigating the challenges of working in fast changing landscapes.
   

  

**The core responsibilities of the Senior eCommerce Manager reflect the following**
* Drive revenue growth on marketplaces across MENA through a data\-driven approach across a portfolio of brands through B2B and D2C marketplaces.
* Ensure that a clear activity plan is in place to achieve and surpass the budget targets, including promotional planning, seasonal phasing, NPD launches, advertising campaigns etc.
* Define the strategy and joint business plan with our brands to create mutually beneficial sales and marketing plans which grow market share.
* Represent your brands brilliantly across Marketplaces through best\-in\-class product content, including but not limited to images, enhanced content, keyword SEO, local language translation, advertising campaigns etc.
* Conduct analysis of brands performance using multiple data sources and tools on a regular basis to ensure that performance is continuously optimised across all touch points.
* Manage inventory, working alongside our merchandisers to maintain a healthy pipeline
* .Establish and maintain relationships with appropriate client partners, providing day\-to\-day contact on project status and changes.
* Have a passion for continuous improvement and building and automating processes.


**What will I need to thrive in this role?﻿**
* Demonstrated success in managing an ecommerce business
* 5\+ years experience in an ecommerce role
* Strong academic background (2:1 or above)
* Previous experience managing and growing 3P business on Marketplaces (Amazon and Noon)
* Creative thinker and problem solver
* Highly organized and disciplined
* Willing to be nimble and adaptable to change
* Able to work under pressure and manage workloads effectively
* Arabic fluency preferred to facilitate communication with local market clients


**We Are Looking For Individuals Who Are**
**Game Changers** 
 \- A game changer is someone who looks at problems with an open mind and shares new ideas with team members, regularly reassesses existing plans and attaches a realistic timeline to goals, makes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern’s processes and outcomes.
   

  

**Data Fanatics** 
 \- A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data.
   

  

**Partner Obsessed** 
 \- An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner’s expectations and delivers results that exceed them, prioritises the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern.
   

  

**Team of Doers** 
 \- Someone who is a part of team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners.

data.jd_text:
The First Group Hospitality is a Dubai\-headquartered, full\-service hospitality management company specialising in hotel operations, asset management, and F\&B strategy. With a team of industry veterans and a proven track record, the company delivers tailored solutions that enhance efficiency, optimise revenue, and maximise asset value for investors and hotel owners.
   

  

 As a trusted third\-party hotel management provider, The First Group Hospitality partners with leading global brands to drive operational excellence and long\-term profitability, thanks to expertise spanning property performance optimisation, cost management, and guest experience enhancement.
   

  

 Beyond management, The First Group Hospitality develops and operates a dynamic portfolio of upscale hotels, residences, and award\-winning restaurants, creating high\-value hospitality assets that stand out in the market. For more information, visit tfghospitality.com
   

  

 The Director of Revenue Management is responsible for maximizing revenue growth and optimizing profitability across all revenue\-generating channels in the hotel. This role entails setting and executing pricing strategies, managing inventory, and analyzing market data to drive revenue performance. The ideal candidate will be a strategic thinker with deep analytical expertise and a strong understanding of market trends, customer behavior, and distribution channels.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
- Strategic Revenue Management

* Develop and implement revenue management strategies and pricing models to maximize room revenue and market share.
* Conduct regular revenue analysis and forecasting to inform business decisions and strategic planning.
* Monitor competitive market trends and adjust pricing strategies as necessary to maintain a competitive edge.


- Inventory and Pricing Control

* Oversee the distribution and management of room inventory across all booking channels.
* Set room rates, packages, and promotions based on forecasted demand, market conditions, and competitive intelligence.
* Manage and optimize distribution channels, including OTAs, brand website, GDS, and other online and offline channels.


- Performance Analysis

* Track, analyze, and report on key revenue metrics, including RevPAR, ADR, occupancy, and market share.
* Regularly review and interpret revenue performance reports to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
* Present findings and recommendations to senior management to support revenue and profitability goals.


- Cross\-Departmental Collaboration

* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Reservations, and Operations teams to align revenue strategies with overall business goals.
* Provide training and guidance to sales and front office teams on revenue management principles and upselling techniques.
* Work closely with marketing teams to develop promotions and campaigns that drive occupancy and ADR.


- Technology and Systems Management

* Utilize revenue management software (e.g., RMS, CRS, PMS) to manage data and make data\-driven decisions.
* Oversee the implementation and maintenance of technology solutions that support revenue management processes.
* Ensure data integrity and accuracy in revenue management systems and processes.


- Market Intelligence

* Conduct ongoing competitive analysis, including pricing, positioning, and market trends.
* Keep abreast of industry changes, new technologies, and best practices in revenue management.
* Develop market segmentation and customer profiling strategies to enhance targeting and pricing precision.


- Budgeting and Forecasting

* Lead the annual budgeting and forecasting process for all revenue streams, including rooms, F\&B, and ancillary services.
* Ensure that revenue targets align with overall financial goals and provide regular updates on performance against budget.
* Identify opportunities to increase incremental revenue through upsell programs and ancillary offerings.
* Bachelor’s degree in hospitality management, Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or a related field
* Minimum 7\-10 years of experience in Revenue Management within the hospitality industry
* At least 3\-5 years in a leadership or multi\-property revenue management role
* Strong knowledge of hotel distribution channels, pricing strategies, and market segmentation
* Experience working with major hotel PMS, RMS, CRS, and channel management systems.
* Proven track record of driving RevPAR, ADR, and occupancy growth Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret and act on complex data sets.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present to senior management and influence key stakeholders.

1\. The Role
 



 Mada Media, a leading privately\-owned outdoor media entity in Dubai, is seeking an experienced
 **Director of Business Development**

 The role is responsible for identifying, developing, and converting business opportunities that support Mada Media’s commercial growth objectives. The Director of Business Development will focus on expanding the company’s B2B client base, building strong relationships with agencies, brands, partners, and key stakeholders, and driving revenue through direct sales, strategic partnerships, and programmatic advertising opportunities.
 



 This position requires a commercially driven leader with strong experience in media, advertising, outdoor media, and digital/programmatic solutions. The successful candidate will be accountable for achieving financial targets, growing market presence, and strengthening Mada Media’s position as a leading media partner in the UAE.
 



 2\. Key Responsibilities
 


* Develop and execute the business development strategy to drive revenue growth and increase market share.
* Identify and pursue new B2B business opportunities across brands, media agencies, advertising agencies, government\-related entities, and strategic partners.

* Work closely with internal teams to ensure business proposals are commercially viable and aligned with operational capabilities.
* Represent Mada Media in client meetings, industry events, networking forums, and partnership discussions.
* Track business development performance, pipeline conversion, revenue forecasts, and achievement against targets.
* Prepare regular reports and updates for senior leadership on business development activity, revenue opportunities, and market insights.
* Ensure all business development activities align with Mada Media’s vision, values, policies, and ethical standards.



 3\. Your Background
 


* Strong track record in achieving revenue growth, financial targets, and business development objectives.
* Proven experience in B2B sales, business development, partnerships, or revenue generation within media, advertising, or related sectors.
* Strong understanding of the advertising market, preferably including out\-of\-home media, digital media, and programmatic advertising.

 Essential

* Proactively originate, qualify, and win new fund sales opportunities across the UAE.

data.jd_text:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Director, Business Development, Corporate Solutions \- B2B Acceptance
   

  

**Overview**
 This role sits within Corporate Solutions and is responsible for developing and scaling Mastercard’s B2B Acceptance strategy across East \+ West Arabia and Eastern Europe. You will help acquirers, PSPs, fintechs and merchants unlock new commercial payment flows.
   

  

 B2B Acceptance is a significant growth opportunity. Corporate buyers increasingly want to pay suppliers using commercial and virtual cards, particularly for invoice\-based payments. For acquirers and merchants, this creates an opportunity to capture new high\-value flows, improve cash flow, reduce manual processes and enable better reconciliation through data and straight\-through processing.
   

  

 Key questions
   

  

* Do you have a track record of building and scaling commercial payment products or acceptance\-led growth strategies?
* Can you influence senior executives across banks, acquirers, PSPs, fintechs and large merchants?
* Are you motivated by solving commercial and operational problems through technology, data and partnerships?
* Can you turn market trends into execution plans that drive GDV, revenue and merchant activation?


 Role
   

  

* Develop and execute the EEMEA B2B Acceptance strategy to retain, grow and expand Mastercard’s commercial acceptance footprint.
* Drive incremental commercial volume and revenue by enabling acquirers, PSPs, fintechs and merchants to capture high\-value B2B and invoice\-based payment flows.
* Remove operational barriers to B2B acceptance, including onboarding friction, manual processing, reconciliation challenges, supplier education and acceptance visibility.
* Build and scale market strategies for virtual card acceptance, supplier enablement, straight\-through processing and automated reconciliation.
* Provide thought leadership to global product teams on B2B merchant, acquiring, fintech, PSP, AP/AR, ERP and embedded finance opportunities.
* Lead digital presence, market insights, research and sales enablement for Commercial Acceptance across Eastern Europe and the Middle East.
* Build educational collateral and go\-to\-market playbooks to support banks, acquirers, fintechs, merchants and internal teams.
* Partner with Commercial Solutions, issuers, acquirers, PSPs, fintechs and account teams to activate commercial acceptance assets and partnerships.
* Manage dashboards and KPIs covering merchant activation, supplier enablement, GDV, net revenue, pipeline conversion and partner performance.
* Ensure Mastercard resources are deployed effectively to support commercial outcomes, market priorities and scalable regional growth.


**All About You**
* Strong understanding of acquiring, merchant economics, commercial card acceptance, virtual cards and B2B payment flows.
* Proven ability to build and scale product value propositions, particularly across acquiring, merchant or supplier enablement.
* Experience in Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, ERP, procurement, embedded finance or invoice\-based payments is a strong advantage.
* Strong commercial mindset, with experience managing revenue growth, pipeline execution, business performance or P\&L\-related outcomes.
* Executive presence and consultative sales experience, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders internally and externally.
* Strong analytical capability, including the ability to use data to build business cases, track performance and shape strategy.
* Collaborative, entrepreneurial and execution\-focused, with the ability to work across a matrixed organization and turn strategy into measurable outcomes.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

**Description**
**About Alvarez \& Marsal**
 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with over 11,000 entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A\&M.
   

  

**The Team**
 The Infrastructure and Capital Projects (Infra) team focuses on improving return on investment capital and reducing the risks specific to capital projects. The Infra team is built on deep industry sector expertise with a demonstrably differentiated ability to address the most complex business problems and by supporting our owner/operator/contractor clients with the expertise of our deep project, Alvarez \& Marsal's ultimate goal is to reduce the level of uncertainty associated with the development and operational costs of your projects, contributing to greater shareholder value drawn from procurement through execution and asset management through different solutions.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute**
 A\&M continues to expand in EMEA, and we are looking to recruit a Director \& Senior Director to be based in our Riyadh office. Working with some of the industry's brightest and most experienced colleagues, you will:
   

  

* Lead the execution of project workstreams, demonstrating expertise and identifying opportunities for process improvement within the assigned tasks.
* Conduct meetings and presentations with clients, as well as internal managerial and executive stakeholders, showcasing proficiency and confidence in discussing project matters.
* Collaborate with teams and clients, engaging in negotiations and fostering effective partnerships between leadership.
* Develop and nurture client relationships, seeking to understand their needs and contributing to their satisfaction.
* Participate in industry events and associations to broaden professional connections and identify potential growth avenues.
* Contribute to the identification and pursuit of new business prospects, aligned with the strategic goals of Infra and other Business Units.
* Drive project analyses, propose actionable plans, and exhibit strong decision\-making capabilities.
* Demonstrate leadership qualities while effectively guiding project delivery.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or master’s degree in business administration, Engineering, or a related field.
* Proven experience in project management and business development, ideally within consulting or related industries.
* 8\+ years experience within public sector large scale projects experience is necessary.
* Arabic language skills is required
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, capable of articulating ideas to diverse audiences.
* Willingness to travel as required.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze complex situations and develop solutions, emphasizing creativity and critical thinking.
* Self\-starter with strong business acumen and a results\-driven approach.
* Ability to adapt and thrive in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.
* Collaborative and team\-oriented mindset.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills for interactions with senior management, clients, and colleagues.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with ambition and risk appetite.
* Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Developing client management skills and aptitude for business development and negotiation.
* Thrives in a high\-energy, fast\-paced, and dynamic culture.


**Your journey at A\&M**
 We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career.
   

  

 We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals.
   

  

 Inclusive Diversity
   

  

 A\&M’s entrepreneurial culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who can positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A\&M’s core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are the main reasons our people love working at A\&M. Inclusive Diversity means we embrace diversity, and we foster inclusiveness, encouraging everyone to bring their whole self to work each day. It runs through how we recruit, develop employees, conduct business, support clients, and partner with vendors. It is the A\&M way.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity Employer
   

  

 It is Alvarez \& Marsal’s practice to provide and promote equal opportunity in employment, compensation, and other terms and conditions of employment without discrimination because of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, sex or gender, gender identity or gender expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, family medical history, genetic information or other protected medical condition, political affiliation, or any other characteristic protected by and in accordance with applicable laws. Employees and Applicants can find A\&M policy statements and additional information by region here.
   

  

 Unsolicited Resumes from Third\-Party Recruiters
   

  

 Please note that as per A\&M policy, we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third\-party recruiters unless such recruiters are engaged to provide candidates for a specified opening. Any employment agency, person or entity that submits an unsolicited resume does so with the understanding that A\&M will have the right to hire that applicant at its discretion without any fee owed to the submitting employment agency, person or entity.

* Lead, manage and develop the commercial team to deliver high standards of performance. Providing guidance, direction and support decision making for their line.
* Oversee and support the development and maintenance of Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) and Cost Breakdown Structure (CBS) frameworks.
* Coordinate commercial processes with wider PMO and functional leads to ensure alignment across the programme.
* Prepare clear, insightful ad hoc reporting and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.
* Work closely with PMO functions on contractual deliverables, coordinating the commercial effort to meet client commitments.
* Provide oversight and governance across cost planning, benchmarking, cost reporting, cashflow reporting, procurement, contract reporting and claims reporting.
* Champion and support initiatives related to continuous improvements within cost \& commercial, cross functions and programmes.
* Define focus areas and related roadmaps for commercial delivery to keep up with and enhance leading practice.
* Manage the client contract and protect Mace’s commercial position. Ensuring compliance with contractual obligations, Protecting commercial entitlement and supporting effective contract administration.


**You’ll Need To Have**
* 15\+ years of relevant experience.
* Degree in a related discipline.

**Integrity \- Always do the right thing:** 
 We influence positive outcomes within our industry, while always aligning with our compliance obligations.
   

  

**Create opportunity \- For our people to excel:** 
 We champion a continuous improvement culture throughout all activities, inspiring our people and teams to develop.

Do you want to love what you do at work? Do you want to make a difference, an impact, transform peoples lives? Do you want to work with a team that believes in disrupting the normal, boring, and average?
   

  

 If yes, then this is the job you're looking for ,webook.com is Saudi's \#1 event ticketing and experience booking platforms in terms of technology, features, agility, revenue serving some of the largest mega events in the Kingdom surpassing over 2 billion sales.
   

  

**Role Overview :**
 webook.com is looking for a Director of Strategy to establish and lead the company's Strategy Management Office (SMO). Reporting directly to the Chief Strategy Officer, this role will work closely with executive leadership and key stakeholders across the business.
   

  

 This position is suited for someone who enjoys building functions from the ground up, creating structure in fast\-moving environments, and driving strategic initiatives from concept through execution.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy Management Office**
* Establish and lead the SMO, including governance models, planning processes, OKR structures, KPI reporting, and executive dashboards
* Coordinate quarterly business reviews and strategic planning cycles
* Track execution of company\-wide strategic initiatives and ensure accountability across departments
* Develop reporting frameworks for executive leadership and board visibility


**Corporate Strategy \& Expansion**
* Support the development and execution of corporate strategy across existing and future markets
* Build market assessment and expansion frameworks for international growth opportunities
* Lead cross\-functional strategic initiatives and monitor delivery against targets


**Investments \& Strategic Partnerships**
* Partner with the investments team on evaluating acquisitions, partnerships, and venture opportunities
* Support commercial and strategic due diligence processes
* Assist with integration planning and post\-deal execution where required
* Develop frameworks for assessing strategic fit and long\-term value creation


**Executive \& Board Engagement**
* Prepare board materials, strategic presentations, and investor\-facing narratives
* Support communication with institutional shareholders and strategic stakeholders
* Provide strategic analysis and recommendations to senior leadership


 Team Leadership
   

  

* Lead and develop members of the strategy team
* Strengthen internal capabilities across strategic planning, execution management, and analytical problem\-solving
* Foster a high\-performance and ownership\-driven culture within the function


**Requirements**
* 8\-12 years of experience in strategy, corporate development, transformation, or a related field
* Experience building or leading a Strategy Management Office or similar strategic execution function
* Demonstrated ability to drive initiatives from strategy through implementation and measurable business outcomes
* Background within high\-growth, scale\-up, PE\-backed, VC\-backed, or pre\-IPO environments
* Exposure to M\&A, partnerships, investment evaluation, or market expansion initiatives
* Experience preparing and presenting materials for senior executives or boards
* Fluent in both Arabic and English


**Preferred Background**
* Experience in live events, entertainment, sports, marketplaces, or consumer technology
* Familiarity with the Saudi and broader MENA business landscape
* Exposure to international expansion across multiple markets


**Why Join webook.com**
* Opportunity to shape strategy at one of the region's most prominent growth\-stage companies
* Direct exposure to executive leadership, institutional shareholders, and board\-level decision\-making
* Ability to build and define a strategic function from the ground up
* Fast\-paced environment with significant regional and international growth ambitions


**This Role May Not Be Suitable For**
* Candidates whose experience is primarily advisory or consulting\-based without operational ownership
* Individuals who have supported strategy functions but not directly led execution
* Candidates who rely heavily on established structures and processes rather than building them
* Limited exposure to executive stakeholder management

data.jd_text:
**Job Summary**
 The Project Director is responsible for the overall leadership and delivery of large\-scale data centre projects in Saudi Arabia within a general contracting environment. The role has full accountability for project performance, including safety, programme, cost, quality, and commercial outcomes, ensuring compliance with Saudi regulations, local authority requirements, and contractual obligations. Working closely with clients, consultants, subcontractors and key stakeholders, the Project Director builds, develops and leads multidisciplinary teams to deliver mission\-critical data centre facilities to the highest standards, while managing local supply chains, Saudization requirements, and fast\-track project demands in the KSA market.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Project Leadership \& Delivery:**
* Provide end\-to\-end leadership for complex, mission\-critical data centre project from mobilisation through commissioning and handover.
* Take full responsibility for project performance, including programme, cost control, quality, safety, and risk management.
* Ensure compliance with contractual requirements, technical specifications, and regional regulations.
* Lead project governance, reporting, and decision\-making at senior and client levels.
* Appointment of individuals to key project positions.
* Work across company functional departments to engage support for on time delivery.


**Client \& Stakeholder Management:**
* Act as the primary senior point of contact for clients, consultants, subcontractors and key stakeholders.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships, ensuring confidence in delivery and responsiveness.
* Manage client expectations and lead negotiations on variations, claims, and commercial matters.


**Commercial \& Contractual Oversight:**
* Oversee commercial strategy in collaboration with commercial team.
* Ensure effective cost control, forecasting, and cash flow management.
* Review and approve major subcontract packages, procurement strategies, and commercial decisions.
* Manage risk, claims, and dispute avoidance/resolution.


**Team \& Resource Management:**
* Build, Lead, mentor, and develop project management, engineering, construction, and support teams.
* Ensure appropriate resourcing, capability, and succession planning for project delivery.
* Promote a strong culture of safety, accountability, and performance excellence.


**Programme, Quality \& Safety:**
* Ensure robust planning and programme controls are in place to meet critical data centre milestones.
* Drive best\-in\-class quality assurance and control processes aligned with data centre standards.
* Champion health, safety, and environmental excellence across all project activities.


**Pre\-Construction \& Business Support:**
* Support pre\-construction, tendering, and bid teams with construction methodology, programme input, and risk reviews.
* Contribute to value engineering, buildability reviews, and logistics planning.
* Support business development efforts related to data centre opportunities where required.


**Preferred Experience \& Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
* 15\+ years’ experience in construction delivery, with significant experience as a Project Director or Senior Project Manager.
* Proven track record delivering large\-scale data centre projects within a General Contracting / Main Contractor environment.
* Middle East \& Saudi Arabia experience, including knowledge of local regulations and practices.
* Demonstrated experience managing large, multi\-disciplinary teams and major subcontractors.
* Strong commercial, contractual, and risk management expertise.


**Key Competencies**
* Executive\-level project leadership
* Data centre construction expertise (mission\-critical environments)
* Client and stakeholder management
* Commercial and contractual acumen
* Programme and risk management
* Decision\-making under pressure
* Safety and quality leadership


**Personal Attributes**
* Strong leadership presence and credibility at client and executive level.
* Highly organised, decisive, and results\-driven.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multi\-cultural teams.
* Ability to operate effectively in fast\-paced, high\-risk, mission\-critical environments.

**Job Description**
 WSP Middle East is seeking a high\-caliber Senior Project Director to lead the successful delivery of a landmark high\-rise tower in Riyadh,KSA. The successful candidate will have an unwavering commitment to quality across every aspect of delivery — from the service we provide and the client relationships we build, to the teams we lead and the construction works we supervise. * Foster a strong client relationship by consistently delivering exceptional service and acting as the primary point of contact.
* Build and manage high\-performing multidisciplinary teams, ensuring collaboration and accountability.

data.jd_text:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consultancy groups specialising in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA's mission is to design safe and sustainable transport solutions to bring people together, develop social inclusion and facilitate access to employment, education and leisure throughout the world.
   

  

 For 65 years, the Group has been working alongside cities and regions to contribute to their development by creating, improving and modernising their infrastructure and transport systems, throughout the life cycle of their projects. SYSTRA is involved from the earliest stages of design through to the testing, deployment and maintenance phases. The company provides all its services in over 80 countries worldwide and generates 74% of its turnover internationally. With its new services, SYSTRA supports its clients and partners in their digital, ecological and energy transition, in order to invent the mobility of tomorrow.
   

  

 Context
   

  

***This requirement is for a bid opportunity only at this stage. Any engagement will be subject to successful project award and final client approval.***
 The Project Director will provide overall leadership and strategic direction for PMCM services on roads and bridges projects, acting as the primary point of accountability for project performance and client satisfaction. The role will be responsible for managing multidisciplinary teams and ensuring that all project objectives are achieved in line with contractual obligations and corporate standards.
   

  

 Subject to project award, the successful candidate will lead project planning, mobilization, execution, and close\-out activities, while establishing robust governance, reporting, risk management, and stakeholder coordination processes. They will oversee project controls, construction supervision interfaces, consultant and contractor performance, and ensure compliance with quality, safety, and regulatory requirements.
   

  

 The Project Director will also be expected to maintain strong relationships with clients, government authorities, contractors, and key stakeholders, while supporting business growth through opportunity identification, bid support, and strategic client engagement where required.
   

  

 Missions/Main Duties
   

  

* Lead and direct PMCM delivery for major roads and bridges projects from inception through completion, subject to award.
* Serve as the senior client interface and ensure effective stakeholder management at all levels.
* Provide leadership to project managers, discipline leads, construction management teams, and support functions.
* Establish and monitor project delivery strategies, execution plans, schedules, budgets, and resource requirements.
* Ensure effective management of scope, risk, change control, quality, HSE, and commercial performance.
* Oversee design coordination, construction supervision, contract administration, and project controls functions.
* Drive timely decision\-making and resolution of technical, contractual, and operational issues.
* Ensure compliance with client requirements, local regulations, and company procedures.
* Prepare and present executive\-level progress reports, dashboards, and performance updates.
* Support recruitment, mentoring, and development of project team members.
* Contribute to bid preparation, technical proposals, and strategic positioning for future PMCM opportunities.


 Profile/Skills
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be a highly experienced infrastructure leader with a strong track record of delivering large, complex roads and bridges projects under PMCM or similar consultancy\-led delivery models. They will possess excellent leadership, communication, commercial, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to operate effectively in demanding, high\-profile project environments.
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
* Minimum 20 years of relevant professional experience in infrastructure project delivery, with a strong emphasis on site\-based execution and project delivery leadership for major roads and bridges projects.
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience in managing projects through key delivery stages, including mobilization, construction supervision, interface management, testing and commissioning, project close\-out, and handover.
* Proven track record in leading the day\-to\-day delivery of large\-scale infrastructure projects, ensuring performance against programme, budget, quality, and contractual obligations.
* Strong practical experience in construction management, site operations, contractor oversight, supervision teams, and resolution of on\-site technical and operational issues.
* Proven ability to manage multidisciplinary site teams and coordinate effectively across contractors, designers, client representatives, authorities, and other project stakeholders.
* GCC experience is mandatory.
* KSA experience is a strong advantage.
* Chartered Engineer status is preferred or equivalent recognized professional accreditation.
* Strong knowledge of SHEQ principles, standards, and implementation practices across major infrastructure projects.
* Demonstrated commitment to Safety, Health, Environment, and Quality leadership, with the ability to embed a strong SHEQ culture across project teams and supply chain partners.
* Proven experience in promoting safe working practices, quality compliance, risk mitigation, incident prevention, and continuous improvement throughout project delivery.
* Strong understanding of contract administration, construction management, project controls, change management, and stakeholder coordination in live project environments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Strong client\-facing presence and the ability to engage effectively with senior stakeholders and public\-sector entities.


 Systra is an equal opportunities company; this position is open to all applicants.

data.raw_snippet:

data.jd_text:
**Overview**
 This is a critical Transformation role responsible for enabling the delivery of the multi\-year transformation agenda. This agenda is key to delivering long\-term sustainable growth (NOPBT margin ambition) for the OU/market and building organization capability for the future.
   

  

 The main pillars of the Transformation function are:
   

  

* Next Chapter Operating Model: Next Chapter organization, GCC, Processes, Simplification, WoW
* Cost Transformation: 2\-3 year productivity pipeline
* Transformation Management Office: develop and maintain integrated business transformation agenda which aligns to the OU/market vision and strategic KPIs
* Lead several key scale x\-functional transformation initiatives: as aligned with senior stakeholders
* Change Management


**Responsibilities**
* Operating Model
* Next Chapter Operating Model:
* Provide Program leadership to Next Chapter for OU/market. Working with OU Next Chapter PMO and CMO, and Region team, to land Next Chapter organization, processes and ways of working, per aligned OU roadmap
* Drive program level visibility and progress, connect the key workstreams.
* GCC:
* Provide program leadership to the OU/market GCC agenda per aligned roadmap: Ensure smooth transition through leveraging global scale and consolidating similar works in HUBs to maximize effectiveness.
* Collaborate with multiple partners in OU/market (Function Leads, People Lead, Comms Lead) and Region GCC team to ensure transition moves according to plan.
* Drive program\-level visibility and progress. Embed overall change management and communications. Manage interdependencies and key risks, escalating as required
* Cost Transformation
* Provide Program management to the OU/market Cost Transformation agenda. Provide program leadership to the OU/market cost agenda, focused on building a medium and long\-term productivity pipeline (next 2\-5 years).
* Drive program level visibility and progress, visibility of pipeline, connect and operationalize the key x\-functional workstreams, working with key stakeholders to size opportunities, mobilize team, build roadmaps/scorecards:
* DTV, Portfolio Harmonization, SC transformation, Procurement, GTM, A\&M, Operating Model (Picasso/Next Chapter/GCC), Digital
* Act as the Lead for Saudi DTV: Key tasks include Sprint Facilitation, Prioritization, \& Planning, SWAT Team Identification \& Onboarding, Value Realization and Brainstorming Ideas based on Benchmarking
* Embed overall change management and communications.
* TMO support to cost transformation governance processes (e.g. Productivity Council, agenda, pre\-reads, and actions as appropriate for OU/market).
* Manage interdependencies of workstreams and key risks, escalating as required.
* Transformation Management Office
* Own delivery of multi\-year OU/market Transformation roadmap, including digital agenda, working in conjunction with key OU stakeholders, Region Transformation and Deployment teams.
* Define overall project management plan leveraging standard frameworks for each program with the Project/Program lead, delivering detailed roadmaps and key milestones
* Define best support for each initiative in conjunction with key stakeholders and identify cross\-functional integration and tension points.
* Provide leadership and governance to these projects, working closely with core project teams, Functions, and OUs as required.
* Leverage project management methodology, guidance, and communication frameworks
* Provide scorecard and performance metrics for each project, manage risk and course correcting as required, and deliver defined benefits.
* Embed overall change management and communications.
* Lead process by prioritizing all investment requests, tracking resources, enabling active risk management, and ensuring value realization.
* Define a multi\-year investment plan and work with project stakeholders to outline the scope, goals, deliverables, required resources, budget \& timing.
* Build tools and capability to support OU/market Transformation agenda: Partner with Sector TMO and CMO to build standard tools, project management, and working methods to ensure execution discipline across our transformation and strategic projects.
* Collaborate with the Global Team to leverage global tools and capabilities and get insights from other sectors on adoption and roll\-out practices.
* Lead key scale x\-functional transformation initiatives (to be aligned with stakeholders)
* Provide leadership and project management to several scale OU/market Transformation projects
* Change Management
* Lead the change management community, plan training for new change leads and impacted managers, and drive effective organizational implementation.
* Working with EMEA Change Lead to seamlessly integrate a clear change management plan.
* Sharing learnings across projects and teams
* Estimate 2\-3 significant projects per year (often multiyear projects)


**Qualifications**
 Key Skills/Experience Required
   

  

* University degree or MBA
* 10\+ years of business experience in leadership roles at Market/OU/Region/Global level in the FMCG sector, preferably with transformation, change management and/or project management experience
* Deep understanding of the OU/market, processes, priorities and goals


 Key skills required for the role:
   

  

* Thinking: Excellent strategic mindset and thinking skills, forward\-thinking, ability to think holistically E2E and connect the dots, ability to frame the right questions and develop frameworks and solutions to solve complex problems. Highly analytical, motivated, decisive thought leader with excellent general management skills – strong bias for action and can\-do approach to work, “out of the box” thinking using traditional and non\-traditional information sources to support recommendations and drive business results.
* Execution: Strong leadership skills and proven track record of partnering with and influencing at all levels of the organization to develop and implement scale transformation or strategic initiatives, working across business functions to set and execute the agenda. Outstanding project management skills and ability to bring clarity and discipline to the transformation agenda. Excellent communication skills and ability to simplify.
* Relationships: collaborative team player who thrives working in an agile and ambiguous environment, demonstrating solid people skills, working well x\-function and x\-BU to align behind goals and delivery
* Agility: flexibility and willingness to take on diverse and challenging tasks, passion for supporting and managing change. Ability to operate in through ambiguity and adapt to changing priorities. Demonstrates courage and conviction required to lead scale changes initiatives and embrace new ways of working.

data.raw_snippet:

data.jd_text:
**About The Company**
 At Flow, we’re reimagining what it means to live, work, and connect. More than just a real estate company, Flow is a brand, a technology platform, and an operations ecosystem spanning condominiums, hotels, multifamily residences, and office spaces. We’re building a new kind of living experience: one that’s flexible, connected, and designed to create genuine community and real value for the people who call Flow home.
   

  

 Our mission is oneness: prioritizing our residents and their experiences, and fostering connection with ourselves, their neighbors, and the natural world. By putting people at the center of everything we do, we’re creating vibrant, human\-centered communities where life, work, creativity, and play all come together in one place.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As Head of Operations, Saudi Arabia, you will lead the operational performance of Flow’s portfolio across the Kingdom, with direct oversight of General Managers and property leadership teams. You will be responsible for building and scaling the operational foundation of the business — ensuring exceptional resident experience, strong hospitality standards, operational consistency, and scalable processes across all properties.
   

  

 This is a senior leadership role for someone with a strong hospitality and property management background who understands how to build systems, processes, and teams in a fast\-scaling environment. You will play a critical role in defining how Flow operates in Saudi Arabia and in building the operational playbook that supports long\-term growth.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Operational Leadership**
* Lead and manage General Managers across the Saudi portfolio, ensuring strong execution, accountability, and operational consistency.
* Drive operational excellence across all properties, including resident experience, maintenance, housekeeping, security, amenities, and hospitality services.
* Establish clear operational standards and ensure consistent execution across all communities.
* Conduct regular property reviews and operational audits to identify gaps and improvement opportunities.
* Build a culture of operational discipline, service excellence, and attention to detail.


**Process Building \& Scalability**
* Design, implement, and continuously improve operational SOPs, workflows, and service standards across the business.
* Build scalable operational systems that support rapid portfolio growth while maintaining quality and consistency.
* Create operational playbooks for property openings, staffing, training, maintenance, resident experience, and escalation management.
* Standardize reporting structures, KPIs, operational reviews, and accountability frameworks.
* Partner closely with product, development, and technology teams to improve operational tools and infrastructure.
* Identify operational inefficiencies and implement process improvements across the portfolio.


**Property \& Hospitality Operations**
* Oversee day\-to\-day property operations with a strong focus on hospitality, service culture, and resident satisfaction.
* Ensure all properties consistently deliver a premium hospitality\-driven living experience.
* Partner closely with facilities, maintenance, and development teams to ensure assets are maintained to the highest standards.
* Drive operational readiness for new property launches, including staffing, systems, training, and service delivery.
* Help define and evolve brand standards for hospitality, presentation, and operational quality.


**Financial \& Performance Management**
* Own operational KPIs across the portfolio including occupancy, resident satisfaction, retention, service levels, and property performance.
* Partner with finance and commercial teams on budgeting, forecasting, and operational cost management.
* Develop dashboards and reporting mechanisms to monitor operational health and performance trends.
* Drive operational efficiencies while maintaining premium resident experience and service quality.


**Leadership \& Team Development**
* Recruit, mentor, and develop high\-performing property leadership teams.
* Create clear accountability structures and performance expectations across operations.
* Foster a strong hospitality\-led culture focused on professionalism, execution, and resident experience.
* Partner closely with country and global leadership teams to align operational strategy with company goals.


 Ideal Background
   

  

* 10\+ years of experience in hospitality, residential operations, property management, or operational leadership roles.
* Strong experience managing multi\-site operations and leading senior property teams.
* Proven experience building operational systems, SOPs, and scalable processes in a growing organization.
* Hospitality background strongly preferred, particularly within premium residential, hotel, branded residence, or lifestyle hospitality environments.
* Deep understanding of operational excellence, resident experience, and service standards.
* Strong leadership presence with the ability to drive accountability and operational rigor.
* Experience operating within Saudi Arabia or the GCC strongly preferred.
* Arabic fluency is a plus.
* Builder mindset with comfort operating in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.


**Why Join Flow?**
**Exciting growth opportunity:** 
 Be part of a fast\-growing company shaping the future of residential living in the Middle East.
   

  

**Competitive Compensation \& Benefits.**
**A chance to make an impact:** 
 Help build a vibrant international community and redefine what it means to call Flow home.
   

  

 If you have the energy, talent, and work ethic to thrive in this role, we want to hear from you! Apply now and be part of Flow’s success story!

data.raw_snippet:
